title.zh: Awesome DSH Plugin 插件精选

description.en: Community-curated DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins, from the awesome-dsh-plugin.com list.
description.zh: 来自 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 的社区 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件精选。

title.zh: WSL 与 Windows 互操作

description.en: Inline annotations for DSH plan review: select plan text, comment on any passage, and send one structured review back to the agent.
description.zh: 给 DSH 计划评审加选区批注：选中计划原文、逐条写意见，一次性把结构化反馈发回给 agent。
为 DeepSeek Harness提供持久化的项目级记忆。专门针对项目开发，原生融合 dsh 任务系统，会话内任务清单与读过的文件自动沉淀为跨会话任务记录，任务↔文件自动关联——开发工作流可切换、可续接，无需重复梳理整个项目。文档与代码符号在读取时索引，无需全量预扫；针对不同语言的项目，支持可选功能增强。经验笔记自动…
description.en: Project memory for dsh with native task-system integration: session todos and file reads auto-condense into cross-session task records (task↔file links), so…
Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live…
description.zh: 把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
description.zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

description.en: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.
description.zh: 把工具结果与会话事件的 receipt 写入本地哈希链 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数、结果正文或原始会话 ID。

description.en: Expires stale dsh-auth sign-in cookies once the Cookie request header passes 4 KiB, so per-port cookie accumulation can never reach Node's 16 KiB header limit…
description.zh: 当 Cookie 请求头超过 4 KiB 时，自动过期失效的 dsh-auth 登录 Cookie，避免按端口累积的 Cookie 撑到 Node 的 16 KiB 请求头上限（HTTP 431）。

description.en: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希（每用户独立盐）、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie（名字按 DSH_HOME 唯一）、按源 IP 登录锁定；邀请码注册；两步验证可用…

description.en: Finds wasted GitHub Actions runner time and proposes small, reviewable workflow patches, with explicit approval before any edit and a DSH settings page for…
description.zh: 找出被浪费的 GitHub Actions 运行时间，并提出小而可审查的工作流补丁；任何修改都需要明确批准，并提供用于分析规则、历史上限、存储和成本估算的 DSH 设置页面。

description.en: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.
description.zh: DSH 主页工作区/会话增强菜单：置顶、重命名、资源管理器打开、归档、分叉、复制、新窗口打开。

description.en: Ask the executing AI — and the auto-review AI when DSH's auto-review plugin is installed and enabled — about a pending tool approval before you allow or reject…
description.zh: 审批等待期间，向执行 AI 提问，装了并启用 DSH 的自动审查插件时也可问自动审查 AI，问清风险与后果再决定；执行 AI 的回答会留在会话里。

description.en: Work reports for DeepSeek Harness: gathers Git commits and local agent conversations (DeepSeek/Claude/Codex) and renders daily, weekly or monthly reports from…
description.zh: dsh 工作报告：汇总 Git 提交与本地 agent 对话（DeepSeek/Claude/Codex），按自定义模板生成日报/周报/月报，agent 工具按需注入。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: agents save, search and update user preferences, facts and project decisions; important entries are injected into…
description.zh: dsh 跨会话记忆：agent 保存、检索并更新用户偏好、事实与项目决策，重要条目自动注入后续会话，设置面板可浏览、编辑、归档与删除。

description.en: Sticky-notes board for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Markdown note panel with auto-save, colors, image paste and task-list rendering.
description.zh: dsh 便签插件：侧栏入口打开 Markdown 便签面板，支持自动保存、颜色标签、粘贴图片与任务清单。

description.en: Usage and cost view for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates real token usage from existing session logs, locks each cost at the price of its event time, and shows…
description.zh: dsh 用量与费用视图：从既有会话日志聚合真实 token 用量，按事件发生时刻的价格写时锁定费用；侧栏卡片或输入框胶囊展示本月/今日花费与预算进度，设置页另有概览、趋势、明细三页。

description.en: Two-way messaging (cc-bridge) between DSH sessions and Claude Code sessions: the CC side needs zero setup (its built-in SendMessage reaches a named DSH…
description.zh: cc-bridge：DSH 会话与 Claude Code 会话互发消息：CC 侧零配置（自带 SendMessage 按会话名直达），DSH 侧注册 cc_send / cc_who / cc_status 原生工具，来件秒级推入会话。

description.en: Translates the agent's English execution narration into Simplified Chinese in place; the final answer, tool records and reasoning stay as they are, so the…
description.zh: 把 Agent 执行过程中的英文过程叙述原位翻译成简体中文；最终回答、工具记录与思考内容保持原样，因此官方思考翻译插件可同时启用。某一步是否属于过程叙述由渲染期结构信号判定，而非依据英文句式；拿不到该信号时不自动翻译。围栏代码、行内代码、URL 与文件路径在请求前打码。复用宿主的翻译服务（默认 Bing，无需 API…

description.en: Check cloud model API costs at a glance: switch which vendor the sidebar cell shows by hand, and adjust how often it refreshes. Its HTTP routes have no DSH…
description.zh: 一个可以快速查看云端模型api费用的插件，支持手动切换厂商，支持调节刷新频率。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A session auto-compaction plugin built for local models (compaction should also drop to seconds on cloud models): when idle it replaces the oldest history with…
description.zh: 本地模型友好的 DSH 会话自动压缩插件（理论上云端模型压缩时间也大大缩短为秒级）；空闲时用摘要替换最旧历史，避免本地模型全量 prefill；触发点可调，压缩后可随时回滚，任务中途也能按余量提前压缩（默认关闭）。

description.en: A plugin that runs any .bat script inside DSH: the terminal log shows up right on the DSH main window. Start and stop it, style the log panel, and drag or…
description.zh: 一个可以在DSH中运行任何bat脚本的插件，终端日志直接显示在DSH主界面，可控制启停，可设置日志面板外观，可任意拖动/缩放。

description.en: Pins the first prompt of the current session in a scroll-proof bar above the conversation: one-click copy, a panel listing every prompt you sent (click a row…
description.zh: 把当前会话的第一条提问常驻在对话区上方，滚动也不消失：一键复制，面板列出本会话发过的全部提问（点某一行直接跳到那条消息，够不着会自动往前翻页），另有十套外观可在面板里即选即换（含四套亮色）。

description.en: One sidebar panel that shows the remaining credit balance and today's check-in state of every freebie platform already configured on the machine (Loomy,…
description.zh: 一个侧栏面板，显示本机已配置的全部白嫖平台的剩余积分与今日签到状态（Loomy、MiniMax Code、Trae、Qoder、Raccoon、WorkBuddy、CodeArts、WPS 灵犀、MobileClaw）；数据通过各平台既有的插件读取，另带两个只读读取器。只做查询与手动签到：不提供登录界面、不保存凭据，且…

description.en: Spice and Wolf theme for DeepSeek Harness: parchment palette, closable 12-second intro, six switchable right-rail standby clips, draggable wordmark and peeker,…
description.zh: 《狼与辛香料》赫萝主题：暖纸色配色、可关闭的 12 秒开场动画、右栏六段可切换待机动画、可拖动的浮动字标与探头、侧栏麦田图层，以及为 dsh-whale-widget 一键导入赫萝角色。

description.en: Starts a whole dev stack from one place: it scans a directory for projects, matches each one's start command, starts them in dependency order once their ports…
description.zh: 一个地方管起整套开发环境：扫描目录发现项目并匹配各自的启动命令，按依赖顺序启动、以端口探测确认就绪，日志带彩色显示在侧栏。

description.en: One image behind the whole DSH shell. The image layer sits at z-index -1 and the shell's two --dsw-* tokens are repointed at translucent tints, so the picture…
description.zh: 给整个 DSH 外壳铺一张背景图：图片层挂在 z-index -1，并把外壳的两个 --dsw-* 令牌改成半透明色，让背景透出侧栏、中栏和输入框。内置一张默认图，装完零配置就有；右下角浮动面板提供五个滑杆、预设档、上传与带 SSRF 防护的链接导入，改动写进本地 settings.json，样式表被 SPA…

description.en: Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on…
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节为第三方模型提供商补齐推理档位（reasoning effort）声明，让 DSH 自带的思考强度选择器对 pi-ai 目录之外的模型真正可用。

description.en: One switch that routes the git, npm and pip commands DSH runs through a local HTTP proxy, restoring every previous setting when turned off.
description.zh: 一个开关，让 DSH 运行的 git、npm、pip 命令走本机代理，关闭时逐项还原原有设置。

description.en: Native Windows desktop control for DSH, 21 tools: UIA control tree plus offline OCR to see the screen, click a control by its name, type CJK without touching…
description.zh: 原生 Windows 桌面控制，共 21 个工具：UIA 控件树 + 离线 OCR 看屏幕、按控件名字点击、不占剪贴板地打中文，微信 / Office / 浏览器 / 网课都能操作。不抢你的鼠标键盘（你在用它会等）、从不改你的窗口大小，侧边栏「指挥台」可随时打字纠正，每步操作后都会回头核对屏幕并如实说明结果。内置持久登…

description.en: Six-layer local memory for dsh: captures turns, stages them through an L2 buffer into DL3 summaries via a staging model, injects a stable memory block each…
description.zh: dsh 的六层本地记忆插件：捕获对话轮次，经 L2 巩固、由分流模型沉淀为 DL3 摘要，每轮注入稳定记忆块并以占位符替代聊天历史。附五个记忆工具与配置页。

description.en: Serial-port capture and troubleshooting for DeepSeek Harness: lossless recordings with a SQLite index, incremental tail, byte-level lookup, workspace scan…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的串口抓取与排障插件：无损录制与 SQLite 索引、增量读取、字节级回查、工作区扫描标记、实时状态机中间件，并提供 Web 面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: CRT cyber-green theme for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar, top bar, composer and popovers share one palette with scanlines and a small toggle switch at the left of…
description.zh: 赛博绿 CRT 配色主题：侧边栏、顶栏、输入框、浮层统一配色并带扫描线，输入框工具条左侧有小开关；配色基于设计令牌，之后新装的插件自动跟随。

description.en: Raises one desktop notification when a turn stops, a question waits, or an approval waits. Each event has its own switch; subagent Sessions stay quiet; a click…
description.zh: 回合结束、有提问等待回答或有审批等待决定时各发一条桌面通知。每类事件可单独开关；子代理会话不发通知；点击通知打开对应会话。走页面自带的 Notification API，不需要辅助程序或安装时注册。

description.en: One hub over every coding IDE you run — dsh, Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Qoder, CatPaw, Trae, OpenCode. Zero-API: it reads each tool's own on-disk state and…
description.zh: 一个入口管住所有编码 IDE（dsh/Claude Code/Codex/ZCode/Qoder/CatPaw/Trae/OpenCode）：零 API 读各自磁盘状态，出会话盘点、按 IDE 用量与缓存命中率、一键恢复命令，并用指针文件把一份规则本体接入全部 8 个工具。国产 IDE…

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer (omd): 48 bilingual skills, 33 role cards and 34 in-process tools — mode state rides the host storageDomain, leaf-guard is…
description.zh: 多智能体编排层（omd）：48 个双语技能、33 张角色卡与 34 个进程内工具——模式状态走宿主 storageDomain 域，leaf-guard 经 tools.restrict 机械强制，cwd/sessionId 从会话锚自动派生，autopilot/ralph/team 由宿主原生…

description.en: Shortcut buttons in the composer row that send preset text into the current conversation in one click. Button label, size, opacity, shape and payload are…
description.zh: 在输入框一行放一组快捷按钮，点一下把预设文字发进当前对话。每个按钮的名称、大小、透明度、形状与发送内容都可就地编辑；右键拖动整组可在上下文进度左右换位，选择保存在本地。按钮组只占自身宽度，不会挤压上下文进度与用量区域。

description.en: Watches download commands (git clone, package-manager installs, curl) and, when one overruns its budget, aborts it and writes a switch-source advisory into the…
description.zh: 盯着下载类命令（git clone、包管理器安装、curl），超出预算就中止，并把一句换源建议写进工具结果，让智能体换个镜像重试而不是对着死源干等。超时按工作类型分别设置，「动手换源」与「只提示」按场景独立开关；另有一个只在卡顿时反应的监督员指示器。

description.en: A run_tests tool that turns a failing test run into precise context instead of a raw dump. It detects the runner (pytest, jest, vitest, cargo, go, npm),…
description.zh: 提供一个 run_tests 工具，把失败的测试运行变成精确上下文，而不是原始大段输出。自动识别测试框架（pytest、jest、vitest、cargo、go、npm），提取每个失败的 file、line 与断言；同一失败签名反复出现时停止循环。输出经过解码，Windows 编码与非拉丁断言文字都能正常显示。

description.en: A vendor index beside the shipped model menu: click a vendor to jump to its models, with optional remaining-credit badges. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access…
description.zh: 在原版模型菜单旁常驻厂商索引：点厂商直达该厂商模型，可选显示按来源探测的剩余额度徽标。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Trellis-style workflow for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn phase breadcrumbs via agent/pre-step, bundled skill provider, and DSH-native task/phase state with…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Trellis 风格工作流：基于 agent/pre-step 的每轮速记注入、内置技能提供方，以及带 git 清洁度护栏的 DSH 原生任务与相位状态管理。

description.en: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
description.zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

description.en: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top…
description.zh: 抓取任意 http/https 网页，提取标题、描述、正文、标题结构与链接，输出字符/词数、阅读时长、语言等统计与高频关键词；支持下载内容图片到会话工作区供视觉分析，并通过 scrape.imageAnalyzer 服务分发给已注册的识图分析器。

description.en: Local long-term memory core for DeepSeek Harness with plain-text notes, a bounded index, five tools, optional host-model consolidation and auditable evidence.…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地长期记忆内核：明文笔记、限长索引、五个工具、可选的宿主模型整理，并保留可追溯原话。它会把每条不超过 32,000 字符的用户和助手消息以明文追加到 ~/.companion/cold/<日期>.jsonl，没有内置清理，并在每次的系统提示词里加一份笔记索引；基于模型的整理默认关闭…

description.en: Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的多平台 API 余额与用量看板：在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阶跃星辰、硅基流动、MiniMax、OpenRouter、Novita、xAI 的余额，估算本会话与子代理消耗并按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价，自动发现 DSH…

description.en: Local three-band memory for DeepSeek Harness: a 24h protection band, query recall and scene replay, injected into sessions without embedding or model calls.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的本地三段式记忆带：24 小时保护带、按话题召回、场景回放，自动注入会话，不调用 embedding 或模型。

description.en: Browses the awesome-claude-video-skills catalog (373 entries) inside DSH settings and installs a chosen skill into ~/.claude/skills and/or ~/.dsh/skills: it…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里浏览 awesome-claude-video-skills 目录（373 条），把选中的技能装进 ~/.claude/skills 和/或 ~/.dsh/skills：下载该仓库的 GitHub 归档并复制技能目录，不执行仓库里的任何代码。安装以后台任务运行、显示实时进度（已下载字节与已复制文件数）…

description.en: A left-sidebar timeline of every file produced across all conversations, newest first, with files changed or deleted after delivery marked in colour. One…
description.zh: 左侧栏把所有对话产出的文件按时间汇总成一条时间线，交付后被更改或已删除的文件用颜色标出。点击对话按钮会跳到该对话、滚到提到这个文件的那一行，并在右侧栏预览中打开文件。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless…
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Tokenrhythm (基元律动) finance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: account balance & expiring credits, category-filtered model price cards (with discounted prices),…
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、按分类筛选的模型价格卡（含折扣价）、服务状态与平台密钥管理，支持平台账号或 Cookie 登录，凭据存本机 host。

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom for the DSH Web UI from 70% to 160%, driven by Ctrl+wheel, DSH's shortcut center or an inline pill, with content-width compensation so…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面整体缩放（70%–160%），可用 Ctrl+滚轮、DSH 快捷键中心或输入框旁的胶囊操作，带正文栏宽度补偿，缩小后是一行更多字而不是一条更窄的栏。

description.en: On every DeepSeek Harness launch, checks the installed and enabled plugins for newer npm versions, lists them in the UI and updates them after confirmation.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时检查已安装并启用的插件有没有新版本，在界面上列出并询问，确认后更新到最新版。

description.en: Lets the AI remember what you said across sessions, and know which facts are still current.
description.zh: 让 AI 记住你跨会话说过的事，并且分得清哪些已经过期。

description.en: CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
description.zh: CapMap 文档体系可视化：Obsidian 风格语义图谱与能力面板。
项目级记忆，核心是台账：台账的结构由 AI 按项目类型自行决定，插件只负责检测、注入、回写、归档与 Git 配合。记忆按语义分开放 —— 活跃台账是当前状态、回合流水只追加、关键决策/目标树/经验教训各是一卡一文件（另有卡片目录的多维索引表），根本原则只有用户本人能改。压缩方式只有一种（分流后压缩）：压缩前先让 AI…
description.en: Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and…
Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮助手：常驻置顶的对话面板，框选屏幕区域直接提问，支持流式回答、模型切换与历史记录。

description.en: Makes every new and existing session resolve to the danger-full-access sandbox with approval set to never, and pins sessions that still carry a weaker…
description.zh: 让每个新建与已有会话都解析为 danger-full-access 沙箱与 never 审批策略，并为仍带着较弱权限的会话补写覆盖。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT,…
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

description.en: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations…
description.zh: 将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL…
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only…
description.zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns,…
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation 控制 Windows 桌面：九个工具读取窗口控件树、按 id 走控件自身的 UIA 模式操作，每次写入都受审批策略、动作日志与设置面板约束。

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline…
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

description.en: Logs what each AI turn changed inside the folders you point it at — which files were created, deleted or modified, and which tool call most likely did it.…
description.zh: 记录每一轮对话在观测目录里改了什么：哪些文件被新建、删除或修改，大致是哪次工具调用干的。不读文件内容。

description.en: QQ protocol backend for DeepSeek Harness on Linux: boots LinuxQQ and NapCat with the engine (first run installs them, about 250 MB) and exposes a standard…
description.zh: 给 DSH 提供 QQ 协议端（仅 Linux）：随引擎启动 LinuxQQ 与 NapCat（首次运行自动安装，约 250 MB），对外提供标准 OneBot 11 接口。

description.en: Reading workspace for DeepSeek Harness: open PDF, EPUB and Markdown in the main view with highlights, notes, concept cards that stay next to the passage, a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的阅读工作台：在主视图阅读 PDF、EPUB 与 Markdown，支持高亮、笔记、留在原文处的概念卡、分层导读与导图，以及由当前会话驱动的阅读侧边对话。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Runs the local nanobot CLI agent as a DSH subagent through a nanobot_run tool: each call carries one self-contained task and returns only the agent's final…
description.zh: 通过 nanobot_run 工具把本机 nanobot CLI agent 当作 DSH 子代理运行：每次只交给它一个自包含任务并仅返回最终答案，可按次启动进程，也可走常驻的 OpenAI 兼容服务。

description.en: Unified MCP, skill and expert management board for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, tool schemas, enable/disable and reconnect for MCP servers across…
description.zh: Skill + MCP + 专家统一看板：MCP 服务器连接状态、工具 Schema、启停与重连（全局与项目双作用域）、SKILL.md 技能启停、WorkBuddy 专家人设可在任意会话随时挂上 / 更换 / 取消（429 位，不受「会话已开始就不能换」的限制）、工具裁缝（扫描本机会话日志统计每个工具的调用次数、错误…

description.en: Adds a Forget action to every session row menu, confirmed by a second click in the menu, that removes the session from the sidebar and from disk: running work…
description.zh: 在会话行菜单加入「遗忘会话」（菜单内二次点击确认），把会话从侧栏与磁盘彻底移除：先停掉正在运行的工作，经官方通道解除工作区、归档与置顶记录，删除日志目录与投影缓存条目，并由复活守卫在一个窗口内补删迟到写入或句柄残留重建的文件；灵枢记忆、附件与其他会话不受影响。

description.en: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by…
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 仓库变成专属 RAG 对话面板：侧栏一个完整页面，左侧笔记浏览、中间检索增强对话、右侧引用原文；检索用完全本地的 BM25 加中文 bigram，回答走 DSH 模型通道，[n] 引用可点击，索引按 mtime 增量更新。

description.en: Grows a conversation into an editable card tree where each card is one self-contained question and answer, with child cards, same-level branches and in-card…
description.zh: 把对话长成一棵可编辑的卡片树：每张卡片是独立成篇的一问一答，可以派生深入卡片、同层分支或卡内追问；全览里能拖动节点、改父级、连引用虚线、删节点或分支。

description.en: Search Wikimedia Commons and Openverse for real photos, download them, and verify provenance, magic bytes and dimensions before they reach your agent.
description.zh: 在 Wikimedia Commons 与 Openverse 搜索真实照片，下载后校验来源、魔数与尺寸，再交给 Agent 使用。

description.en: Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, only the messages you tick (QQ/WeChat-style multi-select), or…
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加一个复制按钮，可复制会话深度链接、整段对话 Markdown、勾选的部分消息（QQ/微信式多选）或工作目录。

description.en: Rewinds a finished turn in place — a button next to your own message withdraws that message and everything after it from the model context, puts its text back…
description.zh: 就地回退已完成的回合：点你自己消息旁的按钮即可把这条消息及之后的内容从模型上下文中撤回，原文回到输入框可直接改完重发，并可一并恢复该回合经 DSH 文件系统服务改动过的文件。

description.en: Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git…
description.zh: 对话与工作区撤销：通过 /undo 节点轴、会话头部按钮或消息下方图标回滚到任意已发送 prompt 之前；插件私有 Shadow Git 快照恢复文件，被回滚回合不会进入模型上下文，误操作还能“撤回回滚”。附带归档会话管理与工具卡片分类配色。

description.en: Registers the Xunfei Loomy cloud channel as an OpenAI-compatible supplier in dsh-router, adding model listing and streaming chat completions.
description.zh: 把讯飞 Loomy 云端通道作为 OpenAI 兼容供应商接入 dsh-router，提供模型列表与流式对话补全。

description.en: Message-level rollback, single-message deletion, and replay-based restore for DSH sessions; operations are append-only surface replacements, with confirmation…
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级回滚、单条删除与重放式恢复；操作以 append-only surface replace 实现，带确认提示和运行中会话保护。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search,…
description.zh: 只读会话惰性查看器：仅 stat 列出会话，再只解压尾部 Zstandard 帧查看最近事件；独立 /lazyview 面板支持搜索、统计和导出。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt;…
description.zh: 跨会话全文搜索：对持久化 DSH 会话日志建立增量消息级索引，返回 sessionId、seq 与摘录；提供 agent 工具和独立面板。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic,…
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key…

description.en: Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with…
description.zh: 领队主导的多智能体团队：把目标拆成任务，按执行链派发给运行在各自子会话里的成员，每个成员可配不同模型。

description.en: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.
description.zh: Agent 交付物的独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 规格进，真实 Chromium 结论出。

description.en: Edits one of your own messages and resends it on a new branch, including while the reply is still streaming; the running reply stops and the replaced…
description.zh: 编辑自己的消息并在新分支中重发，回复过程中也能改（会先停止当前回复，被替换的对话归档而非删除）。

description.en: Read any page as clean main content: charset auto-detect (GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5), noise stripping, compact text/Markdown, offset continuation, optional SPA…
description.zh: 读取网页返回干净正文：中文编码自动识别（GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5）、噪音过滤、紧凑文本/Markdown、offset 续读、可选 SPA 渲染、批量读取与整站爬取。
把 QQ 接进 DeepSeek Harness：私聊群聊、本地语音转文字、看图，以及十个互动工具（戳一戳、贴表情、点赞、发图、发文件、撤回等）。需要本机另跑一个 OneBot 11 实现（如 NapCat）。
description.en: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like,…
A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control…
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes…
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs.…
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机安装的 Moli 无头浏览器：渲染抓取、JavaScript 求值、Markdown、语义树、截图与 PDF。用 CSS 选择器只取某个容器而不是整页（列表页实测省 40–80 倍 token），并支持滚动触发懒加载。Moli 缺失时自动安装；已在…

description.en: Registers two MCP servers that drive the installed AutoCAD and SolidWorks desktop apps over COM, plus two on-demand skills and a delivery check. Windows only,…
description.zh: 注册两个 MCP 服务器，在 Windows 上通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD 与 SolidWorks，另附两个按需技能和一个交付检查。仅 Windows，需要 Python 3.11+；首次加载时自动安装钉死版本的上游服务器，并且只给真正装了的 CAD 应用注册对应的那一行。两个服务器都只广告检索入口…

description.en: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from…
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号汇成一个自动故障转移的模型池，同一池子对外提供 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并支持模型别名、用量统计与积分自动化。

description.en: OpenCode Go control panel: an account pool that rotates A-to-B when a key runs out or stops authenticating, per-account 5-hour/weekly/monthly allowance,…
description.zh: OpenCode Go 控制台：账户池在密钥额度耗尽或鉴权失败时自动 A→B 轮替，按账户显示 5 小时/本周/本月额度，按模型显示用量与剩余额度并标出能力（图像、视频、纯文本、工具调用、推理），实时换算走 OpenCode 还是官方直连更划算；额度路由在上游限流或降级时自动切到 DeepSeek…
侧栏会话状态条：会话跑起来时整行变成绿色卡片，底部一条带流动小点的进度条按估算时长推进，行首直接显示完成百分比，超时后改显示精确到秒的已用时长；跑完后整行转橙并一直亮着，直到你点开那条对话才熄灭。不用切过去看，瞄一眼侧栏就知道每条会话在干嘛。
description.en: A status bar for the DSH sidebar. While a session runs, its row becomes a green card with a progress bar driven by an estimate of how long the turn will take…
Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a…
description.zh: 长会话越跑越贵，平台到点还会把上下文压掉。这个插件做三件事：在会话标题旁显示当前上下文占了多少，鼠标停上去能看到这个数是怎么来的；过 45% 时往工作目录的 HANDOVER.md 写一份交接草稿，记下改过哪些文件、花了多少钱、最近几轮在聊什么；到 60% 提醒你一次该收尾了。平台压缩发生时，它把压缩前的数字记一行，事…

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the…
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before…
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain),…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: A multi-project todo board inside DSH: capture notes in a global capsule overlay, group them into projects and mind maps, and export a todo into the composer…
description.zh: 把多项目待办工作台装进 DSH：全局胶囊浮层随手记想法，归到项目、拆成脑图，再把待办一键导出到输入框交给 Agent。登录后，笔记与待办的读写都发生在作者托管的服务（todo.memorymap.cn）上；可用 config.apiBase 改指向你自己的后端。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: A transparent 3D aquarium in the DSH workbench: two fish species, three planted layouts, drag-to-rotate, wheel zoom and tap-to-startle, with fish food earned…
description.zh: DSH 工作台里的透明三维鱼缸：红绿灯与小丑鱼、三套生态造景，可拖动旋转、滚轮放大、单击玻璃惊鱼，鱼食用 Token 用量兑换。

description.en: Mind-wandering and dreaming for DSH agents - solo reverie, sleep judging, dream play-out with pixelated residue, and waking memory of the dream. Its HTTP…
description.zh: 给 DSH 角色加上走神与做梦：独处联想、睡眠判定、梦境演出、打码残留与衰减副本。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Emotion, energy and per-user portrait engine for AI characters: a 303-word emotion library scored in two steps (pick one of 6 categories first, then choose…
description.zh: 给 AI 角色的情绪·状态·人物画像引擎：303 情绪词分两步打分（先定 6 大类再在类内选词），冷门探索奖励 + 同类冷却保证情绪多样性，精神值阶梯 + 彩蛋式状态跃迁（亢奋/压抑/生气），按人画像，file/onebot 双模式。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 地址与 API Key（环境变量…

description.en: Uploads DSH session logs from non-official model channels (ollama-local, pi-ai, OpenAI-compatible adapters) to DeepSeek, reusing the built-in uploader…
description.zh: 把非官方模型渠道（ollama-local、pi-ai、OpenAI 兼容 adapter）的 DSH 会话日志补传到 DeepSeek，复用内置上传器的水位事件，两条路径不会重发同一条记录；可设为纯手动，不点按钮就不发任何请求。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only event log, rebuildable tag index, day diaries, semantic layer, trend quarantine, and an offline…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层长期记忆：追加式事件日志、可重建标签索引、按天日记、语义层、趋势隔离，以及离线知识图谱面板。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are…
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Two games inside DeepSeek Harness where the model supplies intent and a local engine owns the rules: a twin-brain snake that periodically draws a strategy…
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里玩游戏，分工是模型负责「想」、本地引擎负责「动」：双脑贪吃蛇会周期性抽一张策略卡；中国象棋里模型只从本地生成的合法候选着法里挑一个并解说。模型变慢、断网或额度用尽时，两个游戏都照常运行。

description.en: Runs a local command, an HTTP request or a log entry on DSH lifecycle events (startup, session start/idle/end, user messages, tool results) or on a daily or…
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动、会话开始/空闲/结束、收到消息、工具执行后，或按每天/固定间隔，自动执行本机命令、发 HTTP 请求或写一条日志；左侧栏面板与五个 agent 工具管理同一批规则。

description.en: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL…

description.en: Sidebar file explorer and file previewer for DeepSeek Harness: a lazy workspace tree with in-panel preview for text, Markdown (tables included) and images, an…

description.en: A pinned group above the workspace browser: pinned sessions from every workspace in one collapsible, searchable list, plus pinned Workspaces that unfold their…

description.en: Open .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: cached Blender headless GLB export plus a dependency-free WebGL viewport and scene statistics.…
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB，零依赖 WebGL 视口与场景统计。需要本机安装 Blender 3.6 或更高版本。

description.en: A vertical preview market for DeepSeek Harness: discover preview plugins, inspect the installed inventory, and install, enable/disable or configure them…
description.zh: DSH 垂直预览市场：发现预览插件、查看已安装清单，并通过 dsh-market 或 dsh CLI 安装、启用/停用与配置。一键安装与启用/停用依赖 dsh-market；没有它时卡片只显示可复制的安装命令。

description.en: Play video and audio in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route with desktop seek.

description.en: Open STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: browser-side binary/ASCII parsing, a WebGL viewport, and size/volume/surface-area/watertightness…

description.en: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.
description.zh: 复制会话日志路径（或可直接粘贴的接续块），并把多帧 zstd 会话日志转成可读文件，供另一个会话读取接续。

description.en: A tiled sticky-notes board for the DSH sidebar (a notes plugin): per-row density, colours, pins, search and colour filters, a trash with restore, Markdown…
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏的彩色便签墙（便签插件 / 记事贴）：每行 2–5 个或自适应、置顶、搜索与颜色筛选、带恢复的回收站、Markdown 导出；四个 note_* 工具读写同一批便签。

description.en: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and…

description.en: A proactive coding agent as a DSH bundle: it listens to GitHub issues and comments, and optionally Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom, turns requests from authorized…
description.zh: 以 DSH bundle 形式发布的主动式编码智能体：监听 GitHub 的 issue 与评论，也可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信，把有权限的人提出的请求开成工单，每条工单在自己的 DSH 会话与 git worktree 里执行，并回到原话题以分支或 PR 回话。

description.en: Bundles 19 short-video production skills (1 entry point, 1 orchestration, 17 atomic) into the agent skill catalog: Chinese TTS pronunciation fixes,…
description.zh: 把一条短视频生产流水线的 19 个 skill（1 总入口 + 1 编排 + 17 原子）内置进 agent 技能目录：中文配音读音校正、文生图与文生视频、图片运镜、成片合成、封面、成片核验、数据复盘、四平台发布。本包只提供 skill 与脚本，不安装任何工具：要真跑通流水线，还得本机装好 ffmpeg、Python…

description.en: Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the…
description.zh: 把极空间（ZSpace）NAS 变成 agent 的原生工具：列目录、查属性、按名检索、读取、下载、上传、写入、建目录、重命名、移动、复制、删除 NAS 文件。跨网络走桌面客户端中转——不需要同一局域网、不用 WebDAV、不用 SSH；同一网络时自动改走更快的 WebDAV 直连。删除需显式传 confirm:…

description.en: Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加黑客帝国风格的数字雨开屏动画、向两侧展开的矩形光门、可选的窗口恢复重播，以及可调色相的绿色界面主题。

description.en: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a…
description.zh: AI 回答质量的发布门禁。两条通道：用原 Python 门禁重放 VeriScope 归档，或仅用 Node 对 Ragas 逐条导出做阈值判定，后者不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas。返回通过／失败／待复核，附出处与可复验回执；支持逐条阈值与精确十进制比较。不重新评测、不调用模型，待复核永不转…

description.zh: 把麦当劳中国官方 MCP(mcp.mcd.cn)接入 DSH。粘贴自己在官网生成的 Token 后，插件会握手并调用 tools/list，把远端全部工具自动注册成 DSH 原生工具(mcd_ 前缀)，官方增删工具无需改代码，重启即同步。另附 mcd_status、mcd_test、mcd_tools、mcd_call…

description.en: Credit expiry panel for WorkBuddy, Trae, MiniMax Code, Qoder and Doubao: a sidebar row shows each credit pool balance and its nearest expiry date, and the full…

description.en: A work assistant for WeChat: it records what you tell it into a SQLite task ledger, ranks items by urgency, reminds you on schedule, extracts people and their…

description.en: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and…

description.en: An always-on working style for DSH agents, packaged as an agent preset: restate the task, read before editing, verify each change with a real command, keep…
description.zh: 以 agent preset 形式提供的 DSH 常驻工作方式：复述任务、改前先读、每步用真实命令验证、控制上下文体积。内含 29 个技能（计划循环、评审循环、TDD、卡住换思路、PR 跟踪），以及一个回合守卫：当本轮改了文件却没有在之后跑成任何检查时出言打回，第二次再犯时措辞更硬。

description.en: Moves Shell temporary files out of the workspace, grants write access to the temp directory, explains where temporary files go via the system prompt, and…
description.zh: 将 Shell 临时文件移出工作区，并补齐对临时目录的写入权限，通过系统提示词说明临时文件落点，再按保留天数清理过期的临时文件和无主附件。

description.en: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current…

description.en: Give your agent an external emotion state machine: several axes (0-100) that drift over time and move when you speak to it. Each turn the plugin injects which…

description.en: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set…

description.en: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads…

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.

description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and…
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的已归档对话列表，可只读预览最近消息；针对产品刻意隐藏且无法重新打开的归档会话。

description.en: Per-model token usage and cost estimation with DeepSeek account balance, shown in a Settings panel tab.
description.zh: 按模型统计 token 消耗并估算费用，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展示于设置面板「模型消耗」页签。

description.en: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline…
description.zh: 给 DSH 的输入框加一个全屏输入面板，用于书写多行文本，可移动、可调整大小，与主输入框共用同一份草稿；Enter 只换行、仅 Ctrl+Enter 发送，因此中文输入法不会把 Shift+Enter 变成发送。

description.en: A DSH plugin that provides API-free image generation capabilities. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 免费 API 图像生成插件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Reversible conversation deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a 30-day trash with undo, restore and permanent purge.
description.zh: 可撤销的对话删除：把会话日志与列表缓存移入 30 天回收站，支持撤销、恢复与彻底删除。

description.en: Experimental gesture control for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2+ / 0.2.2-rc.1+ within those minors; desktop media permission required. See compatibility matrix.
description.zh: 用单手手势操作会话；范围限 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起的 0.2.1 和 0.2.2-rc.1 起的 0.2.2。需桌面摄像头/麦克风权限，版本矩阵及旧版补丁见仓库。

description.en: Cross-computer Harness Agent messaging, commit-specific task handoff and parallel-branch or shared-baseline Git project collaboration with diff and conflict…
description.zh: 跨电脑 Agent 通信、带精确 commit 的任务交接，以及分支并行或共同基线 Git 项目协作，提供差异与冲突预览。须先配对、绑定，并遵守接收端本机既有授权。macOS 与 Windows 分发同一个免费评估试用包（UNLICENSED，非开源，勿用于生产）；需要 Node.js 24+，项目协作另需 Git…

description.en: Highlight text in an answer and ask about it in a right-sidebar session that inherits the conversation context, with streaming answers and image/file…
description.zh: 划词提问：选中回答里的文字，在继承主对话上下文的右侧栏会话里追问，支持流式回答与图片、文件附件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Prompt optimizer inside the DSH composer. One click rewrites the current draft with the model you already selected: it classifies the scenario (paper / repo…

description.en: Adds an appearance settings page to DeepSeek Harness: five eye-comfort light themes, each with its own accent and link colours, plus controls for the accent…

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks…

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with…

description.en: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15…

description.en: Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered window that keeps a whale-girl above other applications, speaks through a bubble, comments on its own…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面桌宠：一个 Win32 分层窗口，让鲸鱼娘待在别的应用窗口之上，气泡说话；你在同一个窗口停够十秒它会自己开口，右键弹出的输入框里可以问它一个问题。

description.en: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: each turn can leave a first-person diary entry with a short retrieval index, and the next conversation…

description.en: A Discourse forum management and AI Agent plugin designed for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 而设计的 Discourse 论坛管理和 AI Agent 插件。

description.en: Reasoning-effort slider in the model menu for DeepSeek Harness that also appears for providers and models with no declared effort metadata. Based on…

description.en: Portable Workspace: (1) 100% off the host disk, with sessions, plugins, projects and logs all on a removable drive or USB stick; work portably, no fear of…

description.en: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and…

description.en: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

description.en: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace…
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

description.en: Fusion 360 for DSH: bridges the MCP server Fusion ships (read, execute, update, electronics) with every upstream schema kept byte-for-byte while the always-on…
description.zh: 把 Fusion 360 接进 DSH：桥接 Fusion 自带的 MCP 服务（读取、执行、更新、电子设计），上游 schema 逐字节保留而常驻工具面减少 70%，设置页可改端点，并把本地 hf.py 建模闭环包成九个 hf_* 工具（需要 Python 3.10+ 与 fusion-harness 工作区）。

description.en: Expert center: browse and import WorkBuddy experts, create experts with AI, edit role.md and skills, and switch experts per session.
description.zh: 专家中心：浏览并导入 WorkBuddy 专家，用 AI 创建专家、编辑 role.md 与技能，并按会话切换专家。

description.en: A local + online music player for DeepSeek Harness: multi-root library, NetEase / QQ Music / KuGou / Bodian / Qishui / Navidrome, 14 Folia lyric stages,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地与在线音乐播放器：多目录曲库、网易云 / QQ / 酷狗 / 波点 / 汽水 / Navidrome、14 种 Folia 歌词舞台、歌单与歌词翻译、音频缓存、音量均衡、10 段均衡器与 AutoEQ、智能过渡、列表内搜索、标签与封面编辑。登录凭据与播放数据只保存在本机。它的…

description.en: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning…

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 规划有依赖的工作包，将其分配给已配置的模型 API 或支持的厂商 CLI，并提供费用预览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for querying LLM service provider usage: reads DeepSeek and Moonshot balances plus Kimi For Coding and OpenCode Go quota windows on the…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 服务提供商用量查询插件：在宿主侧读取 DeepSeek、Moonshot 余额与 Kimi For Coding、OpenCode Go 的配额窗口，在常驻卡片中展示，支持三种视图、边缘磁吸与收起为字母气泡。

description.en: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and…
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供个性化设置：Web 设置栏目（关于你、回复风格和语调、标题与列表 / 表情符号特质、输出语言、自定义指令）与 `/soul` 命令；昵称 / 职业 / 介绍 / 风格 / 特质 / 语言编译进提示词并推送给所有活动会话。向其他插件暴露 `soulConfig` 服务，并注册 Agent 可调用的…

description.en: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width…
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 完整工作台 fork：资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git、浏览器与分屏，外加仿 VSCode 外壳重构（全宽紧凑顶栏与活动栏）；npm 包名 @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23。

description.en: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level…
description.zh: 介于 workspace-write 与 Full access 之间的权限模式：命令先经规则与子代理审查，不可逆或系统级操作需人工批准。

description.en: Model brand marks in the composer model selector; vendor and model marks across Settings → Models (provider rows, model rows, the add-provider dropdown); and a…
description.zh: 在输入框的模型选择器中显示模型品牌图标，在「设置 → 模型」页的提供商行、模型行和添加提供商下拉框中显示厂商与模型图标，并提供按提供商/模型覆盖图标的图标选择器，覆盖项保存在 DSH 用户设置文档中。

description.en: CGSS idol theme with multi-character Web colors and card artwork, immersive reading, and an optional Windows desktop companion.

description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中接入 Kimi 模型，并按模型选择嵌入式 Kimi 核心或 DSH 原生执行方式。

description.en: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop…
description.zh: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。

description.en: Turns what a design, plan or document claims into a model and decides it: UML diagrams rendered, read and reviewed; state machines, protocols and data models…
description.zh: 把设计、计划或文档里的声称抽成模型再判定：UML 图渲染、读取与审查；状态机、协议与数据模型按模型判定；迁移检查覆盖与回滚对称；并发声称挖掘后分派给能判定它的工具；依赖图审查；报告对比。

description.en: Embedded C/C++ firmware development toolbox: agents and skills covering FreeRTOS, interrupts, NVM storage, Keil MDK, ARMCLANG, HardFault triage, state…
description.zh: 嵌入式 C/C++ 固件开发工具箱：代理与技能覆盖 FreeRTOS、中断、NVM 存储、Keil MDK、ARMCLANG、HardFault 分析、状态机、架构原则与 LVGL 陷阱。

description.en: Claim-verification skill that checks design documents and plans against codebase facts, escalating behavioral claims to executable logic-primitive verification…

description.zh: 数学建模竞赛多 Agent 求解工作流：「UltraMath」主控预设一个预设跑通 读题→框架→推导→编码→验算→论文→审稿 全流程，另有 数学家/工程师/作家/审稿人 4 个单阶段角色预设与 33 篇模型库技能文档。

description.en: A personal home page for DSH that gathers feature entry points and readings into a card wall: one-click DSH core updates, security review of a plugin before…

description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured…

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and…

description.en: Neutral warm Chobits Chii picture-book skin for the DSH web UI, with light and dark token sets, a polaroid photo wall, and a built-in Live2D Chii mascot with…

description.zh: Windows 专用的 DSH 权限审批弹窗：应用内全局模态框 + 原生 WinForms 系统窗口，语义级高危识别、按类别开关和四种可选颜色。

description.en: Pressure-aware session handoff for DeepSeek Harness: writes a handoff doc before a long session degrades, then continues in a fresh session in the same…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话交接：长会话降智前自动写交接文档，并在同一工作目录开新会话继续；子智能体随交接迁移——仍在运行的先打断，未完成的任务写进续接提示交给新子智能体接手；没有子智能体时就是一次普通交接；「现在交接」的提示词可以在面板里直接改。输入框下方常驻压力提示，状态点与文字颜色随压力从绿…

description.en: macOS 14.2+ only: the macOS counterpart to Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail — the DSH conversation rail pulses with whatever the Mac is playing, a real 12-band…
description.zh: macOS 14.2+ 专享：Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail 的 macOS 对应版，让 DSH 会话页右侧的锚点跟着 Mac 播放的音乐律动，12 段真实频谱只改长度，不覆盖宿主的状态颜色与长度。首次运行需授予「音频录制」权限；请勿与 dsh-audio-rail…

description.en: Smart naming for sessions and workspaces: one click asks the profile model for short name candidates from the item's own content, then renames in place.
description.zh: 会话与工作区的智能命名：点一下让模型基于条目自身内容给出短名候选，选中即改名。

description.en: Pins each message's action row — copy/like/dislike/branch controls, timestamp, and third-party additions — so it stays visible without hovering.
description.zh: 让每条消息的操作栏（复制、点赞、点踩、分支按钮，时间，以及其他插件添加的内容）无需悬停即可常显。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web…
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model…
description.zh: 读取 OpenRouter 实时 /models 列表的模型提供商，新模型无需等待 harness 发版即可出现：模型按名称排序并显示输入/输出价格，按模型提供思考档位、图片输入、reasoning_details 回放、Anthropic 提示缓存，并按 OpenRouter usage.cost…

description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid…
description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：10 个工具（kb_ingest、kb_search、kb_rag、kb_zotero、kb_dedup、kb_clear、kb_fetch、kb_scope、kb_stats、kb_status），BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答，全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件…

description.en: Keeps manually opened Think rows expanded by default, with a per-session switch to open or close every Think row; tool cards stay collapsed and state resets on…
description.zh: 手动点开的 Think 默认保持展开，并提供每会话开关批量展开或收起全部思考；工具卡保持折叠，状态随页面刷新重置。

description.en: A single-character agent that lives across QQ (via SnowLuma / OneBot 11), Bilibili and Douyin (the Douyin channel needs an always-on Windows desktop): persona…
description.zh: 活在 QQ（经 SnowLuma / OneBot 11）、B站、抖音（抖音通道需一台常开的 Windows 桌面）三端的单角色智能体：人格卡与慢慢长出来的人格、按人隔离的记忆（艾宾浩斯衰减、可纠正、聊完自动记）、虚拟时钟驱动的作息与主动开口；设置面板共十个标签，覆盖检索、人格、自走、记忆检视、三端通道、习惯、模型与用…

description.en: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

description.en: UGREEN NAS connector for UGOS Pro: 59 agent tools covering all 70 access-token permissions over OpenCLI — files, storage, task metrics, Docker, downloads, app…
description.zh: 绿联 NAS（UGOS Pro）连接器：通过访问令牌调用 OpenCLI，59 个工具覆盖全部 70 项令牌权限——文件、存储、任务指标、Docker、下载、应用管理、控制面板与全局搜索，按令牌实际授予自动增减。

description.en: Reads and writes a self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden vault from any session: eleven bitwarden_* tools, real-time WebSocket sync with a polling fallback, a…
description.zh: 让任意会话直接读写自建的 Bitwarden/Vaultwarden 保险库：十一个 bitwarden_* 工具、WebSocket 实时同步（不可用时降级轮询）、readonly/ask/auto 三档写权限设置面板，以及可开启的本地脱敏——开启后密码默认以稳定占位符出现，需要时按条目+字段单次取回，落盘会话日志中…

description.en: Bookmark manager for the sidebar browser: toolbar star button, dropdown list with one-click navigation, inline editing and reordering.
description.zh: 侧边栏浏览器的书签管理器：工具栏星标按钮，下拉列表一键打开书签，支持就地编辑与排序。

description.en: Cleanup Mode agent preset for DSH: read-only scans of leftovers (including duplicate detection), a manifest before anything is deleted, trash-first removal…
description.zh: DSH 清理模式 agent 预设：只读扫描残留（含重复文件检测），删除前先出清单，确认后优先移入回收站，并按会话写审计记录。清理工作区之外的位置需要 danger-full-access 会话；workspace-write 下只能检查并会提示你提升权限。

description.en: PromptPolish is an icon-only prompt optimizer beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector: it rewrites the current draft with the active session model and DSH…
description.zh: PromptPolish 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器左侧提供图标式提示词优化：用当前会话模型与 DSH 额度重写草稿，无需 API Key、不自动发送，并带草稿变化保护。

description.en: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume,…
description.zh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

description.en: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and…
description.zh: dsh-router 的 CodeBuddy 供应商插件。单账号负责轮询式 OAuth 登录与令牌刷新，选号、冷却与签到交由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls…
description.zh: dsh-router 的 RTK(Rust Token Killer)扩展插件：把每次 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，让 agent 读到压缩后的命令输出；rtk 缺失或无等价改写时原样执行。

description.en: Qoder supplier plugin for dsh-router, covering both the CN and international regions. Uses a personal access token for authentication, signs requests to the…
description.zh: dsh-router 的 Qoder 供应商插件，同时覆盖国内版与国际版。以个人访问令牌认证、对 Qoder 的 cosy 网关签名请求，并把上游 SSE 转成 OpenAI SSE；模型列表同时上报上游显示名与 key，选号与冷却仍由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status…
description.zh: dsh-router 的 TRAE SOLO 供应商插件，移植自 traework2api。提供 traework 供应商这一免费 SOLO 聊天通道，并向 dsh-router 核心上报单账号状态。

description.en: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an…
description.zh: 以 DSH 插件形式运行的 AI 路由网关。侧边栏新增「路由系统」面板管理供应商、账号池、回退组合与 API 密钥，并在 http://localhost:3080/v1 提供 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Code graph from tree-sitter: codegraph finds declarations, callers, callees, impact and call paths; codegraph_index builds the index, 18 languages.
description.zh: tree-sitter 代码图谱：codegraph 查声明、调用者、被调用关系、变更影响与调用路径，codegraph_index 建索引，覆盖 18 种语言。

description.en: Database structure the agent already knows: dbgraph indexes a remote catalog into local SQLite, answering schema questions offline and fetching data in one…
description.zh: 把数据库结构提前索引好：dbgraph 将远端库的 catalog 索引到本地 SQLite，结构问题离线回答、取数只发一次查询。

description.en: Full-text search of all local sessions: sessiongraph finds conversations in any workspace, Chinese two-character terms included; sessiongraph_index builds it.
description.zh: 本机全部会话的全文检索：sessiongraph 跨工作区查找对话，中文两字词也能命中，sessiongraph_index 负责建索引。

description.en: Hold-to-talk chat between an Android smartwatch and the DeepSeek Harness running on the phone it is paired with: the watch uploads a WAV recording to the…
description.zh: 安卓手表与手机上的 DeepSeek Harness 之间的按住说话对话：手表把 WAV 录音上传到网桥，网桥用主机自带的语音识别本地转写、经真实 DSH 会话作答，再把回复合成为 WAV 播回手表；手表 APK 随包分发，由 /watch/app.apk 直接下载。

description.en: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer…
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness agent 接到 AstrBot，从 QQ 等 IM 渠道驱动它：用 /dsh 派活、引用或 @ 机器人续聊、在聊天里回答审批与 ask_user_question（与 DSH 网页并行），结果、内联图片与文件卡片发回。含会话 / 工作区 / 模型 /…

description.en: Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的转义与主题响应 HTML 代码块渲染服务，基于结构化语法高亮 token，并保留源码换行符。

description.en: Adds a send button beside the composer whose text you can edit, defaulting to "继续", so one click sends that text as your message.
description.zh: 在输入框右边加一个文本可编辑的发送按钮，点一下就把它的文本直接发出去，默认「继续」。

description.en: Bounces between the current session and the previous one with Ctrl+Tab on DSH Desktop, stopping at those two instead of walking further back.
description.zh: 桌面版按 Ctrl+Tab 在「当前会话」和「上一个会话」之间来回切，只在这两个之间打转，不会一路翻回更早的会话。

description.en: Adds one button to the composer toolbar that turns the model thinking on or off on each click, cycling between off and the last reasoning level it used.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行加一个按钮：点一下关闭模型思考，再点一下回到上次的思考档位，如此循环。

description.en: Custom text and image in the Windows desktop title bar, with multi-item rotation, per-item fonts, colors, alignment and shimmer, and a Settings page. Renders…
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面端窗口标题栏显示自定义文字与图片，支持多条目轮播、每条独立字体/颜色/对齐/流光，并可在设置里编辑；非 Windows 桌面端不渲染。

description.en: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks,…
description.zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

description.en: Annotate elements in the right-Sidebar browser (Desktop): click one element or drag a marquee to select a region, then send DOM paths and a change request to…
description.zh: 圈选右侧浏览器里的页面元素发给 AI：单击选一个，按住拖框选一片（弹窗、卡片组、工具条），自动带上 DOM 路径、坐标和文本；HTML 预览可直接一键转到浏览器里标注。仅桌面端。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Composer prompt library: reusable global and per-project prompts are stored as Markdown files, appended to the draft on click or @ mention, and can live in git…
description.zh: 输入框常用提示词库：全局与项目两层 Markdown 文件，点一下或 @ 追加进草稿，不覆盖已写内容，项目库可随仓库进 git。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Sidebar workspace tree: nested sub-workspaces at any level, a session on every level, and sessions pinned to the top of their nearest folder. Nesting derives…
description.zh: 侧边栏工作区多级树：任意一级都能新建子工作区与会话，会话可置顶到所属的最近一级文件夹，层级由目录祖先关系推导。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A real Chrome or Edge for the agent to work in, mirrored in the sidebar so you can watch and take over: every conversation gets its own browser process, with…
description.zh: 让 agent 在一台真实 Chrome 或 Edge 里干活，侧栏同步镜像，你能看着，也能随时接手：每个对话一台独立的浏览器进程，各自的 profile 与 CDP 端口，登录态不会在对话之间串。它驱动机器上已有的 Chrome 或 Edge，不下载浏览器，不需要配套应用或扩展；侧栏镜像开着时，另一个…

description.en: Generate and edit images in DSH conversations using cloud or local models, with provider presets and configurable image APIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中生成和编辑图片，支持云端和本地模型、提供商预设及自定义生图 API。

description.en: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library…
description.zh: 在对话界面新增「3D模型」标签页作为模型库：agent 把 CadQuery 脚本或已剖分的网格存入服务端，标签页用 three-cad-viewer 预览、按文件夹整理，并可导出 STEP、BREP、STL、DXF 等 10 种格式。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on…
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: A compact pill pinned to the right side of the DSH session tab bar that always shows the DeepSeek account balance, today's spend estimated from balance drops,…
description.zh: 一枚常驻在 DSH 会话标签行右侧的胶囊，始终显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、按余额下降估算的今日已用，以及当前是峰时还是谷时定价，不需要点击；未配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 时改走 DSH 账号服务读取余额。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent…
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included),…
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare,…
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when…
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api…

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The…
description.zh: 按提供方与模型保存思考等级：推理强度不再只属于设置它的那次会话，还会应用到 dsh 从不询问的子代理。会话内的手动选择依然优先，没有配置的模型保持提供方默认值。

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is…
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB…

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one…
description.zh: 渐进式工具披露：被延后的工具组在每次请求中只占目录里的一行，模型用 tool_search 加载后才拿到完整 schema；设置页为每个组提供一个开关，各组开销按当前工具注册表实测。

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked…
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when…
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: Digital Earth: opens a 3D globe beside the chat where you can load city models or drone-scanned scenes, measure distances, take screenshots, and run flood or…
description.zh: 数字地球：在对话旁边打开三维地球，加载城市模型或实景三维数据就能浏览；量距离、截图、做淹没和日照分析，也可以一句话让 AI 代劳（支持 3D Tiles / 3DGS）。

description.en: Adds a circular restart button to the session header, plus an optional app.asar patch that also puts a Restart row in the tray menu. Its HTTP routes have no…
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加一枚圆形重启按钮；配合可选的 app.asar 等长补丁，还能在托盘菜单加一项「重启」，先结束进程再把应用拉起来。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Resume a conversation whose turn stopped early: /continue and an action-row button carry the interrupted reply on, covering manual stops, failed model…
description.zh: 从断点继续对话：/continue 命令与消息操作行按钮让模型接着被打断的回答往下写，覆盖手动停止、模型请求失败、输出 token 上限截断与崩溃恢复四种情形，续写提示在被回答后从对话框中回收。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft in three modes (system prompt, user prompt, iteration), keeps {{variable}} placeholders verbatim, and exposes the same operation as…
description.zh: 在输入框里用三种模式改写提示词草稿（系统提示词、用户提示词、迭代改进），{{变量}} 占位符逐字保留，同一操作也作为 optimize_prompt agent 工具提供。

description.en: Scheduled npm updates for the plugins installed in a DSH profile: checks dist-tags on a timer, installs one package at a time and applies it without…
description.zh: 定时检查 DSH 已装插件的 npm 新版本，逐个安装并就地生效，不用重启；每次安装前留快照，可按包回滚，某个版本失败后一段时间内不再重试，带跨进程锁和更新提醒；设置页中英双语、改动即存，并自动清理超过保留期的更新记录与运行日志（默认 3 天）。

description.en: Turns the last 30 days (7 / 30 / 90 selectable) of Session failures into an error museum, with each hall grouping failures by what the model did next…
description.zh: 把最近 30 天（可切 7 / 30 / 90 天）的会话可确认失败做成「错误博物馆」，展品按模型失败后的处置（复原 / 重试 / 交还 / 搁置）分馆陈列，保留失败前后的调用与错误原文。会话日志只在本机读取，只有点「用模型深挖」时才把该会话摘要发给已配置的模型。

description.en: Lets dsh-pet watch screen activity and live audio, then comment through its chat bubble and voice using dsh-see-now's capture pipeline.
description.zh: 让 dsh-pet 实时看屏幕、听同期声音，并通过气泡和语音点评；采集与拼图复用 dsh-see-now。

description.en: Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 现有 Web 界面加上触屏友好的导航、布局微调与独立 PWA 样式。

description.en: Native macOS notifications for DSH: task completion, failures, approval requests, questions and plan reviews. A small bundled helper app lets banners use the…
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 macOS 原生通知：任务完成、失败、需要批准、需要回答、计划确认时弹横幅。内置的极简 helper 应用让横幅使用 DSH 图标、点击唤起 DSH；提示音可以用任意音频文件。

description.en: Queues composer messages sent during DeepSeek peak billing hours and delivers them 3 s after the next off-peak window starts. A dock above the composer shows…
description.zh: 高峰时段按发送自动排队，到谷时（半价）开始后 3 秒投递；输入框上方 dock 显示倒计时并提供立即发送/修改/取消，关掉浏览器或重启 DSH 队列不丢，支持附件。

description.en: Primary and multi-level backup model failover router for DSH, with cross-provider reasoning-effort clamping, exponential cooldown, per-turn recovery, and a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主力模型与多级备用模型自动故障转移插件，支持跨提供商推理强度自适应对齐、指数退避冷却、按轮次恢复及可视化设置面板。

description.en: DeepSeek usage dashboard for DSH Web: days-left estimate from recent average spend, daily/monthly/cumulative costs with period-over-period comparison,…
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek 用量仪表盘：按近期日均消耗估算可用天数，今日/本月/累计花费环比对照，分模型成本排行、缓存节省、峰谷定价影响，以及可拖动的悬浮余额窗。

description.en: Keeps a global ledger of troubleshooting fixes and design decisions, and surfaces a matching confirmed entry when a tool call fails.
description.zh: 把踩过的坑和做过的取舍记进全局账本，工具调用失败时自动带出已确认的相关条目。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
description.zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

description.en: Adds a celebratory fireworks overlay to the DSH Web UI through a happy_fireworks agent tool.
description.zh: 通过 `happy_fireworks` Agent 工具为 DSH Web UI 增加庆祝礼花覆盖层。

description.en: Brings active DSH sessions into a 3D 'Overcooked' kitchen: AI agents work, whale-girls wander the kitchen, and you watch from the side; status bubbles show…
description.zh: 把活跃会话放进 3D 胡闹厨房：AI 在跑任务，鲸鱼娘在厨房溜达，你在旁边看鱼；常驻气泡一眼看清谁在干活、谁在等回应、谁已交作业，点击直达会话继续干活——本来是为了看进度，现在只想再看一眼鱼。

description.en: Configurable deterministic session titles for DeepSeek Harness from semantic prompt fields and templates.
description.zh: 基于语义 prompt 字段与自定义模板的 DeepSeek Harness 确定性会话标题生成插件。

description.en: Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加按 Git Worktree 组织 Session 的视角，同时继续由 DSH 管理原始 Project 和 Session 数据。

description.en: Adds an animated ASCII whale ocean behind empty chats, with neutral frosted-glass input, visual color selection, light/dark support, and configurable whales,…
description.zh: 在空白聊天背景中呈现 ASCII 鲸群与游鱼，提供中性毛玻璃输入框、可视化选色器、深浅色适配，以及鲸鱼、鱼群、栅格和尾迹参数设置。

description.en: Reference workspace files, DSH sessions, and historical ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi conversations from the unified DSH @ menu.
description.zh: 从 DSH 统一的 @ 菜单中引用工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok 和 Kimi 的历史对话。

description.en: Scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness: tagged notes, image/file attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, a wake-up shortcut, JSON export/import, and…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的左栏便签插件：带标签的随手记、图片/文件附件、Markdown 待办、发到对话、唤起快捷键、JSON 导入导出，以及 Agent 工具。

description.en: Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault,…
description.zh: dsh 的个人收件箱：输入框的 /inbox 或侧栏面板把链接、图片、文本与账密收进本地仓库，先按本地规则、再由有每日上限的模型分类，可在面板里筛选、搜索与编辑；对话里让助手按需检索取回，账密正文加密落盘，可选 WebDAV 或 S3 远端同步记录与附件字节。目前只在 Windows 实测。

description.en: Imports sessions from pi, opencode, codex, claude-code and WorkBuddy into DSH, unifies AGENTS.md, skills, project and per-agent memory across harnesses with…
description.zh: 把 pi、opencode、codex、claude-code 与 WorkBuddy 的会话导入 DSH，用符号链接在各 Harness 间共享同一份 AGENTS.md、技能、项目与 Agent 记忆，并把 Codex / WorkBuddy 自动化迁移为 DSH 定时任务。

description.en: Zero-intervention permission gate for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents on macOS — active on install. Writes that can be undone via a local git baseline or macOS…
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH 智能体的零干预权限门 —— 安装即生效。可经本地 Git 或时间机器回滚的写操作自动放行并自动打快照，拦截网络、装包、进程 / 系统管理与敏感路径读取，并记录完整审计日志（可配置启用自动清理最旧审计记录）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for qvasp: a skill bundle with the full 88-command reference of the qvasp VASP toolkit (INCAR/KPOINTS/POTCAR templates, structure…
description.zh: qvasp 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 qvasp（VASP 前后处理工具）。技能包收录全部 88 条命令的用法与坑，MCP 服务端可运行 qvasp 命令、提交前检查输入、执行 10 个标准多阶段工作流（弛豫、能带、DOS、声子、光学、弹性、MD、表面、虚频修复）、用 spglib…

description.en: Turns new mail from every dsh-email account into dated to-dos: drops codes, alerts and newsletters without a model call, reads attached .ics invitations…
description.zh: 把所有 dsh-email 邮箱的新邮件变成带日期的待办：验证码、登录提醒、订阅推广不调用模型直接过滤；附带的 .ics 会议邀请直接读取；用 DSH 默认模型提取要做的事和截止时间（失败时退回规则，可多封并行）；仅抄送的邮件不建待办；跨邮箱去重并标注时间冲突；后来的邮件说改期或取消时，原待办跟着改时间或关闭。待办写入…

description.en: Clickable next-reply chips under each assistant turn: the reply itself ends with up to three suggested follow-ups, so no auxiliary model call is made, and a…
description.zh: 每条回答下方显示可点击的下一步建议：建议由主回复自身给出，不额外调用模型；点击可立即发送，或只填入输入框待你修改。

description.en: Loopback HTTP/SSE service that lets an Obsidian plugin drive DSH sessions and tells the model which note you are reading and what you have marked (path, size,…
description.zh: 让 Obsidian 插件驱动 DSH 会话、并把「你在读哪一篇、标记了哪里」这类坐标交给模型的回环 HTTP/SSE 服务（只给坐标，正文留在磁盘上，需要时自己去读）；AI 在编辑器里有自己独立的光标；需要在 Obsidian 内配套运行插件。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin console: inspect plugin information, session sources and tool ownership, preview context content and the impact of disabling a plugin, and…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件控制台：查看 DSH 插件信息、会话来源与工具归属，预演上下文内容与插件禁用影响，并支持提示词/工具定制首次请求。

description.en: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be…
description.zh: DSH Web Composer 视觉增强与会话工作台：实时 Markdown 呈现与光标行源码还原（非焦点行语法标记可完全隐藏或淡化显示）、确定性本地补全、列表与引用的换行自动续行及有序列表重编号；超长粘贴自动收纳为持久化引用 chip，支持直接内联或文件送达（支持 50+…

description.en: Detects Minecraft mod and plugin projects (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Architectury, Paper) and runs their Gradle client or server task from the session header,…
description.zh: 识别工作区里的 Minecraft 模组与插件工程（Fabric、Forge、NeoForge、Architectury、Paper），在会话标题栏运行 Gradle 的客户端或服务端任务，日志显示在侧栏标签；数据生成与 GameTest 这类会跑完的任务在结束时给出通过或失败的结论。

description.en: DSH Console: a pairing panel inside DSH settings — scan the QR code or type the six-digit code to connect your phone to this computer's DSH, then send…
description.zh: DSH 控制台面板：在 DSH 设置里显示扫码配对面板，手机扫一下二维码（或输入 6 位码）就连上这台电脑的 DSH，之后在手机 App 里收发会话、看历史、传文件。全部能力都在本机跑，局域网内不依赖云端。

description.en: AgentTeams for DeepSeek Harness — an independent design branch of NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams; do not install both, since both register the same `agent-teams`…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AgentTeams 多智能体团队协作插件，NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams 的独立设计分支；不要与上游同装：两者注册同一个 `agent-teams` 行。提供队长与成员、带依赖的任务与消息传递，全部由自然语言驱动，Web 界面提供树状实时监视。

description.en: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on…
description.zh: 把发给模型的工具 schema 统一归一化成 Gemini function declaration 能接受的 OpenAPI 3.0 子集：每个节点补 type、数组补 items、剔除空 enum 项、内联 $ref，让"任何一个 MCP 或内置工具不合规"不再把整包请求打成 HTTP 400。

description.en: New Concept English Book 1 study panel: 144 lessons with text, IPA vocabulary, grammar and a Bilibili video on one page, Anki-style spaced repetition, a…
description.zh: 新概念英语第一册学习面板：144 课在一页内读完课文、带音标的词汇、语法和配套视频，配 Anki 式间隔重复、错题本，以及由你自己的模型批改的可填写练习卷。

description.en: Registers the domestic-China trip-planning skill: hour-level daily timelines, 12306 and Trip.com booking deep links, offline KML, and seven HTML themes.…
description.zh: 把境内旅行规划技能注册进 DSH 技能目录：逐小时每日时间线、12306 与携程/去哪儿预订深链、离线 KML 与七套 HTML 主题。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+（内置脚本仅依赖标准库）。

description.en: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线可用的 UI/UX 设计智能库：内置 84 种设计风格、192 个配色、74 组字体、99 条 UX 规范、25 种图表与 22 个技术栈，提供 design_recommend / design_review / design_search…

description.en: Describe what you want to draw in DSH, or provide a PNG and say what to change. Export a PNG and editable JSON, or recolor a selected area. Drawing needs…
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中说出想画的内容，或提供 PNG 并说明要怎么改。可导出 PNG 和可编辑 JSON，也可按指定区域改色。绘制需要带 Pillow 的 Python 3.10+。

description.en: Ctrl+F searches the current session and a double Ctrl tap searches every DSH session log: message text and tool output are indexed as separate partitions in a…
description.zh: Ctrl+F 检索当前会话，双击 Ctrl 跨会话检索全部 DSH 会话日志：正文与工具输出分区写入本地 SQLite FTS5 索引，中文按两字窗口切词，短词查询走索引而不是全表扫；命中可跳到那条消息，或开右侧预览。预览需前置插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Open source links from DeepSeek Harness conversations at the referenced line, review Git diffs beside the chat, inspect paused variables, and turn explanations…
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对话点击源码链接，直接跳到指定行。在右侧工作台查看 Git 差异和断点变量，也可以把讲解保存为可搜索的 Markdown 记忆卡片。支持 Python 类关系图（Beta）。Go 和 Java 跳转需要语言服务器，断点调试需要调试适配器。

description.en: Use Pi, Qoder CLI, MiniMax Code, DeepSeek Harness, Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode v2 as independent subagents for DSH through session-scoped MCP, with…
description.zh: 通过按会话限定的 MCP，让 DSH 将 Pi、Qoder CLI、MiniMax Code、DeepSeek Harness、Codex、Claude Code 和 OpenCode v2 作为独立子智能体委派和管理，支持可选的持久会话，并提供按项目和会话组织的 WebUI，可查看状态、结果与轨迹、处理审批和取消任务…

description.en: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering,…
description.zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

description.en: Renders Google A2UI 1.0 surfaces (cards, tables, charts, forms, sliders and function plots) inside DSH conversations; local interactions need no model call,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话内渲染 Google A2UI 1.0 界面（卡片、表格、图表、表单、滑块与函数图像）；本地交互不产生模型调用，按钮与表单把一次动作回传给 Agent。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚排序：将 sidebar.footer.action 槽位改为上下堆叠，并允许用户配置各条目自上而下的排列顺序。

description.en: Installs four multi-agent math-research presets for DSH: v2 (probability-driven pipeline with multi-verifier debate), v3 (paper-style Markdown knowledge base…
description.zh: 为 DSH 安装四个多代理数学研究预设：v2（概率驱动流水线 + 多验证器辩论）、v3（论文式 Markdown 知识库 + 规划代理 + 可复用方法库）、v4（常驻自组织成员，靠留言与开会决定一切）、v5（研究所：院士拆解并分派任务、有表决权的研究员、临时工、群聊与 CAS…

description.en: C++ audit skill: detects the target project's actual C++ standard before making any recommendation, then reports findings across RAII and ownership, move…
description.zh: C++ 审查技能：先探测目标工程真实的 C++ 标准再给建议，随后按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器与算法、并发、模板与编译期、标准边界、类型安全、ABI 与接口设计逐条给出结论，每条含检查点、原因、反例→正例与适用标准。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard…
description.zh: 归档会话管理插件：按工作区分组浏览，FTS5 全文检索会话内容并展示多条命中摘要，支持恢复并打开与彻底删除。

description.en: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy…
description.zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文，收紧标题、列表与块级节奏，使用圆角引用条，并把表格补成带主题化表头、行列分隔、短表铺满和宽表容器内滚动的 Tidy Tables；无设置项、不改写 DOM，仓库内附真实前后对比图。

description.en: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.
description.zh: 把完整 Web Session 导出为本地 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，提供稳定的 Markdown 渲染预览、默认脱敏和可选的有界工具调用详情。

description.en: Open the current registered Workspace from the Session Header or Workspace menu in a detected or configured editor, with hot re-detection and a remembered…
description.zh: 从 Session 页头或 Workspace 菜单用检测到或配置的编辑器打开当前已登记 Workspace，支持热重新检测和浏览器首选项记忆。

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: Full-interface whale skin pack for the DSH Web UI — layered wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner mascot that reacts to agent state, ambient…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面全屏鲸鱼皮肤包：多层壁纸、金/银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、随 Agent 状态反应的角落立绘与环境粒子，并支持可安装的第三方皮肤包格式。

description.en: Free vision OCR with adaptive tile recognition for long documents and Markdown/Word/PNG/Excel export.
description.zh: 免费视觉识别插件：自适应切块长文档识别，支持历史收藏与 MD/Word/长图/Excel 导出。

description.en: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and…
