description.zh: 把代码仓库与运行中的系统变成验收材料：数据库设计、概要设计、详细设计、带截图的使用说明书，以及测试报告、上线报告、验收报告。章节按 GB/T 8567-88 组织，无法核实的字段与结论一律留空，不编造。需 Python 3 与 python-docx 生成 .docx，自动截图需 Google Chrome。

description.en: Bring WorkBuddy, Qoder and Trae subscription models into DeepSeek Harness with multi-account failover, per-account HTTP(S) proxies and model visibility…
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy、Qoder、Trae 的订阅模型接入 DSH，支持多账号故障转移、账号级 HTTP(S) 代理与模型可见性管理。登录与对话经社区维护的 opencode-*-auth 适配包（随插件安装、版本固定）访问各家国内站点；账号与令牌存放在 DSH 凭据库，默认只显示免费模型。

description.en: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle,…
description.zh: 会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。

description.en: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions,…
description.zh: 经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。

description.en: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows the account balance behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with the peak/off-peak billing…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看峰谷计费时段、切换倒计时与各模型价目表。

description.en: Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a…
description.zh: 为 compaction-basic 提供压缩兜底：当 LLM 摘要抛错、返回空内容或放不进上下文窗口时，改为确定性编译该区段，每行带 seq 指针（内置 dsh-compaction-instant 编译器）。提供 recall、search 工具与 /recall、/context 命令，占用超过窗口 45%…

description.en: Fronts stdio MCP servers with three router tools (list_capabilities, describe_tool, call_tool) so schemas load on demand instead of riding every request;…
description.zh: 用三个路由工具（list_capabilities、describe_tool、call_tool）代理 stdio MCP 服务器，schema 按需加载，不再随每次请求发送；所有工具结果经过确定性输出阶梯压缩，有损处理前先归档原文（retrieve_spill 可读回）；按 token 为工具分组标价，并可按…

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already…
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加网页对话入口，将 DeepSeek 网页对话打开在应用内窗口中，方便工作时临时提问。基于 zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat（已在目录内）的分支；使用独立设置命名空间，可与上游共存。需要桌面端桥（window.dsh.desktop.openWindow）。

description.en: A memory plugin that forgets on purpose: short-term memories expire after 48h, long-term ones are rescheduled by Ebbinghaus/SM-2 curves and rarely-used ones…
description.zh: 会遗忘的记忆插件：短期记忆 48 小时自动过期，长期记忆按艾宾浩斯/SM-2 曲线复习，久不用的沉进沉睡区（可唤醒）而不是无限撑爆上下文。长期写入停在审核中心，模型不能自行改写人格设定。

description.en: Per-session document ledger in the DSH sidebar (Windows only, Chinese-language UI): which documents a session read, created or modified, with time ordering,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏按会话查看文档台账（仅 Windows，界面仅中文）：用过哪些文档、创建/修改了哪些，带时间排序、类型分组、搜索与两种预览。

description.en: Restyles only the model answers in the DSH Web UI: font family, body and heading weight, and a color for bold runs, with a one-click reset. Its HTTP routes…
description.zh: 只给 DSH 的模型回答换字体、调正文与标题字重、给加粗片段上色，随时一键恢复默认。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Seasons DeepSeek Harness replies with a light dialect flavor — Northeast, Tianjin, Beijing, Cantonese or Hakka (Meizhou Xingning, experimental) — behind a…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回答偶尔掺一点方言口气（东北话、天津话、北京话、粤语、客家话·梅州兴宁，试验中），五档频率（关闭到约 50%）、三档强度，输入框旁可按会话单独切换。

description.en: Four model-callable tools that render HTML to PNG, screenshot a page or element, annotate an existing image, and return a style guide, using the installed…
description.zh: 四个模型可调用的工具：HTML 渲染为 PNG、网页或元素截图、给已有图片画框与箭头、读取样式指南，直接使用本机 Chrome 或 Edge。

description.en: Turns a local ComfyUI into a drawing agent with twelve tools, per-family prompt guides, PNG recipe recovery, missing-model search and installation, and the…
description.zh: 把本机 ComfyUI 变成绘画 agent：12 个工具、分族提示词指南、PNG 配方反解、缺失模型搜索安装，以及「极简绘画」预设。

description.en: Wallpapers with pointer parallax, frosted-glass panels, composer and sidebar styling, and sidebar auto-hide for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 壁纸与指针视差、毛玻璃面板、输入框与侧边栏样式，以及侧边栏自动隐藏。

description.en: Floating A-share limit-up card in the DSH overlay showing limit-up, broken-board and limit-down counts, break rate, consecutive-board height, previous-day…
description.zh: DSH 浮层里的 A 股涨停直播卡片：显示涨停/炸板/跌停数、炸板率、连板高度、昨日涨停溢价、热门题材与 localStorage 自选股；可关闭且浮层无残留（从侧边栏底部恢复）。数据来自仓库 dashboard/ 下需单独运行的 Python 看板后端（需 Python 3.9+ 与…

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the…
description.zh: 输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片：接管模型选择器，显示当前档位、模型行，以及覆盖模型适配器所报全部档位的分段滑块；另带模型列表、重置，以及最高档时的紫色极光与闪烁粒子。

description.en: A Cyrene-themed agent for DSH, with a customizable look (palette, wallpaper, particle effects, background music, typing sound) and a code security scan. It…
description.zh: 给 DSH 用的昔涟主题 agent，包括可自定义美化主题（配色、壁纸、粒子效果、背景音乐、打字音效）与代码安全扫描。拥有世界书、长期记忆与说话方式修正（一千个人心中有一千个昔涟），剧情检索增强回答。

description.en: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的字体插件：对话有自己的字体、字号、行高、字重、字距、词距、段距与首行缩进，界面字体跟随对话，代码独立成轴并支持连字；亮色与暗色可各调一套，整套配置存为预设，另有一个悬浮调参面板。

description.en: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a…
description.zh: 模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单，以及每轮结束的完成通知；各自独立开关，只作用于界面。

description.en: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲：按回合整理整段会话的 Markdown 标题，侧边面板与全屏「幕布」两种视图；悬停预览可钉住对照，书签留住常回看的几处，右键即可跳转到某一节或复制标题及其下面所有层级。支持六种主题色与半透明材质、标题/提问/全文/跨会话搜索、阅读位置跟随与中英双语界面。

description.en: A zero-config composer model picker with one provider per tab, independent scrolling per provider, cross-provider search with provider badges and…
description.zh: 零配置的输入框模型选择器：每个 provider 一个 tab、各自独立滚动，支持带渠道徽标的跨渠道搜索和推理强度 chips，并与内置 /model 弹窗共享同一份模型目录。

description.en: Local, WSL, SSH and Docker workspaces in one list, with the right sidebar's file and terminal panes served by this plugin, plus one remote tool for every…
description.zh: 本机、WSL、SSH、Docker 工作区统一到一个列表，右侧栏的文件与终端面板由本插件接管，并提供统一的 remote 工具。

description.en: Previews plugin-market entries inside DSH instead of opening an external browser: clicking a card shows the README in a panel docked beside the market, or the…
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件市场点击插件卡片时把插件留在 DSH 里预览：README 显示在市场旁的停靠面板，或在内置右侧栏浏览器打开仓库页，离开市场时恢复原布局。支持 dshmarket 与 DSH 内置实验性市场。

description.en: Add a WSL directory as a DSH workspace from the sidebar's Add workspace button: pick a distribution, browse the Linux tree, and the directory is registered as…
description.zh: 在侧栏的「添加工作区」按钮里把 WSL 目录加成 DSH 工作区：选发行版、浏览目录后以 \\wsl.localhost 路径注册；该工作区的侧栏终端开在发行版里，agent 也能正常写入其中的文件。需 Windows 10/11 并已安装 WSL。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH conversations with optional recursive deletion of forked and subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从 DSH 中永久删除会话，并可选择递归删除派生对话和子智能体会话。

description.en: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.
description.zh: 把 agent 的文件改动审查放进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 或对话尾部行，支持行级 diff 与撤销。

description.en: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches,…
description.zh: DSH 模型可见性管理：在独立的设置分区页里按渠道/模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。逐模型开关、实时搜索、渠道级批量隐藏/显示、一键恢复全部。零侵入——只写插件自己的隐藏列表，不改 Provider 配置，隐藏正在使用的模型不会中断会话。

description.en: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with…
description.zh: 可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。

description.en: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak…
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's…
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: PCL-style modpack for DSH plugins: export a small .dshpack.zip manifest of the selected third-party plugins and their versions, then import it with a preview…
description.zh: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已安装插件导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与安装命令串，导入时先预览、确认后再按版本重新安装。

description.en: Per-workspace gate that hides the tool schemas and system prompt sections of selected plugins from the model in directories that do not need them.
description.zh: 按工作区门控插件：把选定插件的工具 schema 与系统提示词段，从不需要它们的目录的模型上下文中摘掉。

description.en: DSH bundle that vendors the full mattpocock/skills tree, preserves upstream invocation policies, and applies an exact-match DSH semantic overlay checked during…
description.zh: 将完整 mattpocock/skills 技能树打包为 DSH 插件，保留上游调用策略，并在自动同步上游时校验和应用精确匹配的 DSH 语义适配层。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: Aardio development tools and skills — keyword search over the local installation, a configurable aardio folder, open-in-IDE, and compile/run inside the IDE…
description.zh: aardio 开发工具链：检索本地安装里的文档与示例、在插件页选择 aardio 目录、把文件交给 IDE 打开，并通过可选的 IDE 桥接编译运行代码。

description.en: Personal agents with persistent memory, multi-Bot group collaboration and native background tasks for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人智能体插件，支持持久记忆、多 Bot 群聊协作和原生后台任务。

description.en: Dispatches tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs and provides a sidebar panel for CLI availability and dispatch status.
description.zh: 从 DSH 向 11 种外部 Agent CLI 派遣任务，并在侧栏面板显示 CLI 可用性和派遣状态。

description.en: Image generation and image reading for DSH: an Images page in the sidebar, labelled 图像 in Chinese (one row per model, 10 ratios, 1K–4K sizes, a contact sheet…
description.zh: DSH 的生图与读图：侧边栏「图像」页面（英文界面显示 Images；按模型分行、10 种比例、1K–4K 尺寸、联系表 + 详情卡 + 放大 + 复用 + 删除），三个预设提供方外加自定义端点（其中一个完全免 Key），另有 vision-review 读图技能。粘进去的 Key 只写进本机…

description.en: Task-to-skill pairing meta-skill with a laziness ladder for minimal loading, a user-editable routing table, and a quarantine, SkillSpector scan, human-approval…
description.zh: 任务到技能配对元技能：懒人阶梯最小化加载、可编辑路由表、隔离-SkillSpector 扫描-人工确认的安装流程。

description.en: Windows desktop integration, a one-click launcher and tray controller for DSH, plus a sidebar button that puts DSH and a chat.deepseek.com window side by side…
description.zh: Windows 桌面集成：一键启动器 + 托盘控制器，另加侧边栏按钮把 DSH 和 chat.deepseek.com 并排放置并共用一个任务栏按钮。安装会写入桌面快捷方式并注册 dshsplit: 协议，两者都可用 lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove 清除。

description.en: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh…
description.zh: 在输入框下方的状态栏里实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 读数：可点击的徽章、详情面板、逐项开关与三档刷新速度。

description.en: Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.
description.zh: 归档管理：在设置页列出已归档会话，并可真正删除，连同会话日志、归档标记与投影缓存一并清理。

description.en: Peak / off-peak reminder at the start of every turn, then the turn's cost, average cache hit rate and daily total, with a live period badge in the composer…
description.zh: 每轮对话弹出高峰/低谷期提醒，回复结束显示本轮花费、平均缓存命中率与今日累计，并在输入框状态栏常驻时段徽章。实用又美观。

description.en: Kifu-style context compression for long DSH sessions: each step folds new turns into a DAG (node = position, edge = attempted fix), injects only a ~417-token…
description.zh: 棋谱式上下文压缩：每步把新回合折进一张 DAG（节点=局面、边=试过的改法），只注入约 417 tokens 的热清单（2000 边合成夹具、L5 降级档）；带失败记忆与局面重复检测。一段历史只摘要一次，保留率不随压缩轮次衰减。

description.en: Session-level superagent: watch one GitHub repository and wake this session when an issue or pull request changes; requires a logged-in gh CLI, and the…
description.zh: 会话级 superagent：盯一个 GitHub 仓库，issue/PR 有变化就唤醒本会话；需已登录 gh CLI，凭证留在插件内，不进模型。

description.en: Durable cross-session memory plus a fetch ladder that survives hostname-keyed blocking. Four tools: memory_recall, memory_save and memory_stats over a…
description.zh: 跨会话持久记忆，加一条绕开主机名级封锁的取数阶梯：四个工具——memory_recall / memory_save / memory_stats 读写 $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json 里的纯 JSON，resilient_fetch 依次尝试直连 fetch → 同服务别名主机（目前仅…

description.en: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页编辑全局 AGENTS.md 和项目 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 个性化指令，提供项目指令链浏览、字节预算显示与保存冲突处理。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice…
description.zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search,…
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

description.en: Adds per-session routine and enhanced tool review for DeepSeek Harness, with routine review allowing common actions and sending changes such as whole-file…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按会话切换的日常与加强审查，日常审查按规则放行常规操作，并在覆盖整个文件等变更前交给独立模型审核。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱通知插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时通过微信（Server酱 Turbo）或 Server酱³ App 发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。

description.en: Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with…
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: Replaces the default DeepSeek Harness identity text in the system prompt with a neutral introduction for selected models.
description.zh: 为选中的模型把 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示词中的默认身份介绍替换成通用措辞。

description.en: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and…

description.en: A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget…
description.zh: 右下角常驻的小鲸鱼挂件：余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗（含峰谷价），余额预警与今日预算的泡泡内容都可编辑；泡泡点击序列模块化自定义，支持并列加权 A/B、随机台词与随机图片；内置 30+ 厂商模板（OpenAI / OpenRouter / Kimi / 硅基流动 / 方舟 / 智谱 / MiniMax…

description.en: Alt+drag a rectangular box over the DSH conversation to copy the text inside it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中按住 Alt 拖拽矩形选框，复制框内文本。

description.en: Your AI learning companion: helping you plan your studies, understand concepts, and build projects to master a subject.
description.zh: 你的AI学习搭档：定计划、讲知识、做项目，学透一门科目。

description.en: Turn a one-line requirement into verified delivery. TeamFlow runs a multi-stage pipeline — triage, PRD, design, technical plan, parallel development, QA with…
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成可验收的交付。TeamFlow 跑一条多阶段流水线——分诊、PRD、设计、技术方案、并行开发、带打回重修的 QA、验收——并给模型 12 个 `teamflow_*` 工具，以及带实时流水线图与 backlog 看板的工作台。每个需求一个专属目录，收着 PRD、设计、技术方案、QA 报告与验收记录。

description.en: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
description.zh: 增加可召唤的领域专家名单，专家以子代理运行，主会话保留任务和最终答复。

description.en: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.
description.zh: 在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without…
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a…
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question…
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

description.en: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
description.zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

description.en: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and…
description.zh: 提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.
description.zh: 在设置里管理本地 DSH 技能，并只读查看公共 Agent 技能。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa…
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision…
description.zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and…
description.zh: 把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地运行的 Unsloth Desktop（Unsloth Studio）服务器：unsloth_run 与 unsloth_vision 两个工具，纯 HTTP 客户端，不拉起也不持有任何进程。

description.en: Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles…
description.zh: 持续监控 DSH 与插件发布，在一次性隔离环境中复测精确发布物，发布机器可读的兼容性证据，并在修复后自动核对和关闭受管理的问题。

description.en: Drags the official reasoning-effort row into a continuous track: blue-to-violet fill, a starfield on the higher levels, and the official value text tinted to…
description.zh: 把官方「推理等级」那一行改成一条可拖动的连续轨道：填充从蓝渐变到紫罗兰，较高档位带星尘粒子，官方数值文字跟着档位变色。Off 档保持官方灰，不改写官方任何文字。

description.en: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts,…
description.zh: 在每条已完成回答的操作条增加「术语」入口，用内置离线词典给出回答中计算机术语的中文释义、提及次数、高亮上下文，并支持点击释义中的术语展开次级解释，不调用模型。

description.en: Tianlight theme/skin for DeepSeek Harness: full-screen video and image wallpapers (bundled 4K video by default) with upload, rotation, URL and ShaderToy GLSL…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「天光」主题皮肤：全屏视频/图片壁纸（默认随包 4K 视频），支持上传、轮播、URL 与 ShaderToy GLSL 代码来源；可选 WebWallGL 场景壁纸；可浏览本机 Wallpaper Engine 库（Steam 创意工坊与本地项目），提取场景预览，并把场景录成最高…

description.en: Replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account — reads the bound DSH workspace, writes the answer, and sends it back through the dws CLI.
description.zh: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

description.en: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management…
description.zh: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

description.en: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
description.zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

description.en: Offline Wikipedia and ZIM lookups through your own kiwix-serve: the wiki_search, wiki_read and wiki_books tools run full-text search with snippets, read an…
description.zh: 通过你自己运行的 kiwix-serve 离线查询维基百科等 ZIM 数据包：wiki_search / wiki_read / wiki_books 三个工具分别做带摘要片段的全文搜索、按精确标题读取全文、列出本地 ZIM 书库。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export…
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: WeChat-style theme for the DSH Web GUI: green accents and send action, green user bubbles, a soft gray chat canvas, a green sidebar whale, a badge on the…
description.zh: 微信风格主题：微信绿强调色与发送按钮、绿色用户气泡、浅灰聊天画布、绿色鲸鱼图标、当前会话的「当前」徽标，上下文使用率状态点，以及醒目的上下文压缩卡片。

description.en: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet,…
description.zh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

description.en: Complementary web-search provider: every web_search merges the DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary) at a fixed 2:1 ratio.…
description.zh: 互补式网页搜索 provider：每次 web_search 由 DeepSeek 官方 Search API（主）与 serper.dev 的 Google 结果（补）按固定 2:1 交错合并。两路均为直连检索、无辅助模型调用；来源按 URL 去重，官方长摘要截断注入，单路超时自动降级到另一路。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft in place: the panel streams a structured rewrite above the input, a line diff confirms the replacement, and a nine-second undo…
description.zh: 在输入框里就地改写提示词：浮层在输入区上方流式生成结构化改写，替换前逐行 diff 确认，替换后 9 秒内可撤销；附带本地历史、版本对比、7 套模板与变量抽取。

description.en: Adds quit and check/update controls to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, plus an optional KDE tray, per-feature settings, remembered window size, and safe cache…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面增加退出与检查/更新控件，并提供可选的 KDE 托盘、分项设置、记住窗口大小和安全缓存清理。

description.en: Frosted-glass appearance studio: adjustable transparency and blur, image or video backgrounds, six light/dark surface palettes, type sizes for text, code, and…
description.zh: 毛玻璃外观工作室：可调透明度与模糊度、图片或视频背景、六套浅色/深色表面配色、正文/代码/终端字号，以及可选的品牌标记。

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

description.en: Consensus academic search and research agent with interactive paper cards and native OAuth.
description.zh: Consensus 学术检索与研究 Agent，支持原生 OAuth 与会话富交互论文卡片。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: Interactive HTML or flowchart cards inside the conversation: the tool blocks until the user submits, then returns the clicked action, fields, comments and card…
description.zh: 在对话里发可交互的 HTML 或流程图卡片；工具阻塞到用户提交，再把点击、字段、评论和卡片状态作为结果交还。

description.en: A desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top character and a roster panel that show what the watched conversations are doing, with seven animations,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面宠物：置顶角色加一块会话面板，显示受关注会话的实时状态；七套动画、按 Workspace 分组、子代理挂在父会话下面、点击一行即可打开会话。包内自带 Windows、macOS（Intel 与 Apple 芯片）和 Linux 的窗口可执行文件，安装时不跑脚本、无需构建。

description.en: Adds Mojie (mojieaigc.com) as a DSH model provider, so its models appear in the model picker, and registers the native image tools plus the /image command for…
description.zh: 把 Mojie（mojieaigc.com）接入 DSH 的模型提供商，模型出现在模型下拉里，并注册原生图片工具与 /image 命令，用于生成与编辑图片。

description.en: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus…
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

description.en: Fork of shaobeichen/dsh-pocket for remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: QR-code access over LAN or a cloudflared tunnel with live sync; mobile layout is left…
description.zh: shaobeichen/dsh-pocket 的 fork：手机扫码经局域网或 cloudflared 隧道远程访问 DSH Web 界面并实时同屏；移动端布局交还 DSH 官方，插件只补安全区与触控样式，软键盘回车换行、外接键盘回车发送，安装与更新交给插件管理器。命令行模式默认监听 0.0.0.0，好让同一…

description.en: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM…
description.zh: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm 的 Node.js 分支：同样的 WinRM 主机面板与七个 agent 工具，后端从 Python/pywinrm 移植到原生 Node WinRM 客户端，运行 dsh 的机器不再需要 Python。

description.en: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow…
description.zh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word…
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里：按 → 接受，也可以直接开始打字、用 Ctrl+→ 逐词补齐，Esc 关闭。预测模型默认跟随当前会话，也能在设置卡片里指定；卡片里还有总开关和测速。

description.en: Replaces the default web search and fetch channel with eight free search engines including Tavily, Exa and Brave, tried in a configurable fallback order. Keys…
description.zh: 把默认的 Web 搜索与抓取通道替换为 Tavily、Exa、Brave 等八个免费搜索引擎，按可配置的顺序依次 fallback。在设置卡片中填写各引擎 Key，并可开关 web_fetch 工具。

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and…
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

description.en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description.zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

description.en: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time…
description.zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

description.en: Local dataset analysis tools for DSH: ingest CSV/JSONL once, then head, schema, stats_describe, transform_agg, list, export and rm against a workspace store…
description.zh: DSH 本地数据分析工具：CSV/JSONL 入库一次后，用 head、schema、stats_describe、transform_agg、list、export、rm 在工作区 .dsh-analyze/ 存储上分析，由路径受限的 dsh-analyze CLI 执行。需另行安装该 Rust…

description.en: Answers real-life decisions from a 765-entry Chinese life guide: looks up entries first, ranks by cost and benefit, and cites section and item.
description.zh: 按《高性价比人生指南》765 条正文回答人生决策：先查条目，按成本与收益排序，每条注明第几节第几条。

description.en: Update checker for plugin bundles installed in a DSH profile: a Version section on the detail page of a plugin installed from a GitHub repository or release…
description.zh: 检查 DSH profile 内已装插件包更新的工具：从 GitHub 仓库或 release tarball 安装的插件，其详情页会出现 Version 分区，把已装 commit 或版本与确切目标版本对照；/plugin-updater 命令可列出插件包、检查 npm、Git 仓库与 GitHub release…

description.en: Star-ranked radar for DSH plugins. A plugin is listed once it has 3,000+ GitHub stars or 100k+ npm downloads in 30 days; after its rank drops it stays listed…
description.zh: 按 GitHub 收藏数排名的 DSH 插件热度榜：收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万即收录， 排名下滑后仍保留 180 天（默认），热度过去几个月依然找得到。

description.en: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and…
description.zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

description.en: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart…
description.zh: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

description.en: Switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves across the whole interface, not just a few screens; each works on its own and more arrive as the…
description.zh: 调 DeepSeek Harness 整体观感与操作的开关集合，管的是整套界面而不只是某几块；每个开关独立生效，随宿主能力增长继续增加。包含 8 套极简主题的画廊（每套为浅色与深色各定义一组配色，通过单一主题变量层整套换色）、把侧栏面板行收成一个「面板」入口的收纳功能（点开是两列启动面板，带搜索与键盘操作），以及侧栏底…

description.en: Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while…
description.zh: 把浏览器里的 DSH 会话变成鲸港简版客户端：独立 --app 窗口、客户端顶栏与任务通知；后台多源下载完整桌面安装包（SHA-256 校验），完成后提示安装。

description.en: An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
description.zh: 由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.

description.en: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
description.zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

description.en: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screens…
description.zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek ASR recognizer for the built-in Voice input bundle: the microphone records 16 kHz mono WAV and transcribes it through the paid /v1/tools/asr endpoint,…
description.zh: 为内置 Voice input bundle 提供的 DeepSeek ASR 识别器：麦克风录制 16 kHz 单声道 WAV，经付费的 /v1/tools/asr 接口转写，无需下载本地模型，转写结果作为可编辑草稿插入输入框。

description.en: Lets one session consult another: it reads the target history into a bounded digest, has a read-only child agent answer from it, and returns provenance with…
description.zh: 让一个会话去咨询另一个会话：把目标历史读成有界摘要，交给只读子会话作答，并在每次回答后附上出处（来源、截到第几条、丢弃了多少）。

description.en: Bridges the shared ~/.agentloom store between DeepSeek Harness and Codex: injects the shared memories and the AGENTS.md entries the context budget truncates…
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 与 Codex 接到共享的 ~/.agentloom：将共享记忆与被上下文预算截断的 AGENTS.md 条目注入系统提示，并提供 status、sync、记忆检索/列出/写入与技能列出的六个 loom_* 工具。需先安装 agentloom CLI 并执行一次…

description.en: Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
description.zh: 通过 context7_search 与 context7_get_docs 工具，为 DSH 智能体从 context7.com 获取最新、可锁定版本的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations and submenus. Since 0.4.0 it bundles a…
description.zh: 给 DSH 顶端加一个可扩展的「功能」栏：插件注册的一键动作都在这里，支持分级确认与二级菜单。0.4.0 起自带了「重启 DSH」功能，不再需要单独安装重启插件。

description.en: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness…
description.zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互——象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙强调色、三字体排版、权限分段控件与品牌切换，以 CSS 覆盖与客户端 DOM override 实现。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Windows Desktop only. Adds a 重启 item to the DSH window caption menubar next to 应用 and 编辑; the second click stops the app and starts the same executable again…
description.zh: 仅 Windows 桌面版。在 DSH 窗口标题栏菜单（应用 / 编辑）后加一个「重启」项，连点两次即由 WMI 拉起的 PowerShell 脚本结束应用并重新启动同一个可执行文件。

description.en: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and…
description.zh: 把语雀文档作为 dsh 的外部记忆：对话中自动检索并注入相关文档片段，支持目录快照检索、云端全文搜索与在线阅读。

description.en: Load skills to reveal bound tools on demand, with per-tool blocking and MCP support.
description.zh: 加载技能后按需解锁绑定工具，支持按工具拦截和 MCP 工具。

description.en: FishPai: a WeChat Official Account typesetting and editing workbench with a professional canvas, interactive components, and human-model collaboration.
description.zh: 鱼排：公众号排版与改稿工具，支持专业画布、交互组件、人与模型协同与一键复制到微信。

description.en: Project-scoped Git credentials: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per…
description.zh: 项目级 Git 凭据：forge 账号（GitHub、Gitea、GitLab、Bitbucket 或自定义域名）在右侧栏「Git 凭据」标签页里管理并可按项目授权，再由生成的凭据 helper 交给 agent 走 HTTPS 推送，token 不进对话；未授权 host 的推送会被拦截器直接拒绝。

description.en: AI PowerPoint (PPT/PPTX) maker: twelve ppt_* tools create, redesign, edit, quality-check and export presentation slides as editable .pptx or PDF, import and…
description.zh: PPT 制作插件（PowerPoint / 幻灯片 / 演示文稿）：十二个 ppt_* 工具创建、美化改稿、质检并导出可编辑的 .pptx 与 PDF，可导入或修改已有 PPT，内置 30 套设计系统与右侧栏可视化工作台，用于汇报、答辩、路演与课件。

description.en: Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right…
description.zh: 多机 SSH 工作台：把远程服务器收进主机库、按项目授权，在右侧栏里开交互式终端或双栏 SFTP；模型用 SSHManager 工具远程执行命令、上传下载文件，密钥不进模型上下文。

description.en: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition…
description.zh: 把小爱音箱（小爱同学 / 小米智能音箱）接成语音助手的插件：托管本地桥接器进程，听到唤醒词就收音、做语音识别（ASR / STT），把对话交给 DSH 会话，再用语音合成（TTS）把答案念回音箱播报。

description.en: Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the…
description.zh: 提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。

description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed;…
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: A /agentinit command that builds, repairs or audits a repository's AGENTS.md inside a subagent: the child reads the method file itself and checks every command…
description.zh: /agentinit 命令：在子代理里生成、修订或审计仓库的 AGENTS.md。方法文档由子代理自己读取，写下的每条命令与路径都用随包的只读检查器核验，主对话不进入任何指令正文。随包的检查器是 Python 脚本，需要 Python 3 在 PATH 中。

description.en: Replaces the built-in compaction provider: at a configurable fraction of the context threshold (85% by default) a detached task summarizes everything up to the…
description.zh: 接管内置压缩 provider：默认在上下文达到阈值的 85%（比例可配）时，起一个游离任务把截至上一轮的历史总结成摘要；摘要就绪后的下一个回合边界直接把它提交为 checkpoint，这一步 0 次模型调用、耗时毫秒级。/bcompact [消息] 按需发起同样的生成，随后照常发送你的消息。设置页可改自动触发比例、摘…

description.en: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a…
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置面板增加「快捷键」页面：六个可改键命令（权限模式切换、思考强度调节、状态页、任务清单），并展示翻页键跳转与可选的输入框 Enter 重映射。

description.en: Split long DSH conversations every 10 user messages by default, with todo handoff snapshots, source links and read-only archives; declares DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or…
description.zh: 长会话默认每 10 条用户消息自动分卷，支持待办快照续接、来源回溯及归档只读；声明兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或 >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: Persistent model-planned task trees with execution-time child sessions, recursive delegation, readable task-local progress and direct-parent completion…
description.zh: 由模型规划并持久保存任务树，执行时建立子会话，支持递归委派、可读的子任务执行记录、对话增量调整及直接父任务完成通知。

description.en: A task progress sidebar for DeepSeek Harness Web and desktop with a top-right Tasks button, completion percentage, current step, status filters and details;…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web / 桌面客户端的任务进度侧栏：从右上角“任务”查看完成比例、当前步骤、状态筛选与详情；声明兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或 >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: Global and project text memory with original-message citations, revision history and managed source withdrawal. Public beta.
description.zh: 保留原话引用、修改历史并支持受管来源撤回的全局与项目文字记忆。公开测试版。

description.en: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.
description.zh: 一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。

description.en: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered…
description.zh: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

description.en: Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from…
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：在输入框旁边直接选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、 Qwen Code、Gemini CLI、Aider、Goose、Hermes…）作为当前会话的默认执行体，不必去改配置文件。 Agent 名册是数据驱动的，已安装的 CLI 会从…

description.en: Recovers the images and documents your past sessions carried: find attachments by topic across every stored session, get the original file path, or copy them…
description.zh: 把历史会话里带过的图片和文档找回来：按主题跨会话搜附件、拿到原始文件路径、或一次性复制出来。 上下文压缩器只压缩当前窗口里的东西，会话检索返回的是引用文本——两者都给不回原始文件。此外每轮 把一个按工作区定位的 Markdown 记忆文件注入系统提示，支持多关键词 AND、时间窗与工作区过滤的…

description.en: Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host…
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 提供原生图片上传体验：在 Web GUI 粘贴/拖入图片即以缩略图附件进入会话，发送前由 host 用免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash 视觉 API（glm-4v-flash 降级链）读取并替换为文字描述，DeepSeek 据此回答，原图保留在聊天历史中。

description.en: Ships a minimal lesson ledger: brief.ps1 to look up past pitfalls, add-lesson.ps1 to record new ones, deployed into the skills directory and wired into…
description.zh: 自带一套最小账本工具：brief.ps1 查过往踩过的坑，add-lesson.ps1 记新的，安装时自动部署到技能目录并接好 AGENTS.md。模型动手前查一遍、踩坑后记成规则，同一个坑不必踩第二次。本插件负责盯着它有没有真的这么做，并把「查了几次、记了哪几条」摆在面板和输入框下方。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good…
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: Team Skill Hub: browse shared public or private team skills from a Skill Base server and install them in DSH Web.
description.zh: 团队 Skill 中心：连接 Skill Base，浏览团队共享的公开或私有技能，并一键安装到 DSH Web。

description.en: Sends DeepSeek Harness turn-completion, pending-approval and pending-question alerts to a phone through the MeoW push service, with per-event toggles and three…
description.zh: 通过 MeoW 推送服务把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务完成、待确认与待回答提醒发到手机，支持按事件开关和三种消息格式。

description.en: Adds 17 barotrauma_* tools to DeepSeek Harness for making Barotrauma mods: environment probing, mod skeleton, item and weapon XML, afflictions, creatures,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 17 个 barotrauma_* 工具，用于制作潜渊症 mod：环境探测、内容包骨架、物品/武器/状态效果/角色/随机事件 XML、Lua 与 C# 脚本脚手架、本地化、校验、图标生成、打包与创意工坊发布文案。barotrauma_gen_icon 会把你的提示词发到…

description.en: Adds handoff, context-decision and context-diagnose skills, self-contained context_pressure/context_history tools (peak tokens, compaction stats), per-route…
description.zh: 新增交接、上下文决策、上下文诊断三个技能，自带 context_pressure/context_history 工具（峰值 token、压缩复盘），支持按线路实测窗口 realWindows（含 windowSource 证据）、routeKey 直出与 handoffAt 强制交接线，附斜杠命令。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.en: Controls the Chrome you are already logged into: the model clicks, types, fills in forms, reads pages, takes screenshots and downloads files in your real tabs,…
description.zh: 操作你已经登录的 Chrome：模型在你真实的标签页里点击、打字、填表、读网页、截图、下载文件，同源 iframe 里的内容也能读能点。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux；需要 Chrome 116+ 与 Node 18+。走 native messaging 与…

description.en: Design workbench in the right sidebar. Since 1.0 it has a title bar (project menu for kind and size, screen switcher, share, export, build as code), one bottom…
description.zh: 右侧栏的设计工作台。1.0 起顶上一条标题栏（项目菜单改类型和画幅、切屏、分享、导出、转成代码），底下一条工具栏（选择、改字、调样式、画笔、试用、外观、体检），模型干活时变成带计时和「停下」的状态胶囊；各个面板都从底部升起，一次只开一个；命令面板 ⇧⌘K（Windows 是…

description.en: Vision-first Mac computer use, for when the accessibility tree is unavailable. Ships 11 desktop_* tools - window list, screenshots, OCR text targeting,…
description.zh: Mac 的视觉优先 computer use：无障碍树不可用时照样能干活。11 个 desktop_* 工具——窗口枚举、截图、OCR 找文字、元素编号、坐标点击、输入、滚动、拖拽，外加 Codex 风格的浮层光标（带弹簧动效）。点击投递给目标进程，不移动真实鼠标、不抢前台。DSH 插件页里显示为「Mac…

description.en: Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the…
description.zh: 在手机浏览器里用 DSH。点会话顶栏的手机按钮（或插件设置卡）打开手机访问、扫二维码，手机就打开电脑上 DSH 进程提供的官方网页界面，会话相同、实时同步，人不在电脑前也能跟进正在跑的任务、回消息、点批准。DSH 里内置一个网关（端口 18765）转发网页界面，并替手机处理桌面端登录。一个二维码在 Wi-Fi…

description.en: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 10 built-in templates (report, compare,…
description.zh: 让模型把回答做成一页网页，直接放在对话里。show_page 工具可以套 10 种内置模板（报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图、思维导图、技术路线），模型只写内容，排版、交互和保存由插件做；也可以存模型自己写的整页（计算器、小游戏、特别的版式）。思维导图分支左右展开、节点能折叠；技术路线能画申报…

description.en: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player…
description.zh: 在对话流里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型这一轮写出的媒体文件（录屏、转码、配音），只要路径出现在它跑的命令、命令输出或回复里，回合收尾时播放器就自动出现在回复正下方，不用调工具；别的文件用 play_video 工具播放。视频是带悬停预览的小卡片，音频是可拖进度的细条，走 HTTP Range…

description.en: Watches the context budget of a DeepSeek Harness session: a colour dot in every turn footer (green <50%, yellow 50-65%, orange 65-80%, red >=80%) read from the…
description.zh: 看护 DeepSeek Harness 会话的上下文预算：每轮回复底部一个颜色点（绿<50%、黄50-65%、橙65-80%、红≥80%，读官方 contextPressure 投影），橙/红档在输入框下方出现提醒与「一键开新会话」交接按钮，另有 /context-watch 与 /handoff…

description.en: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness with C0–C3 policy, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先注意力监督，提供 C0–C3 策略、去重 Inbox 提醒、静默时段和脱敏结果记录。

description.en: Zero-restart acceptance lab for DSH plugins: boots a real cordis Loader and ToolsService in a subprocess, drives the mounted plugin through scenario scripts,…
description.zh: DSH 插件的零重启验收实验室：在子进程里启动真实 cordis Loader 与 ToolsService，用场景脚本驱动挂载的插件，逐项给出 PASS/FAIL 与总体判定。

description.en: Research workbench with evidence-bound findings, guard receipts, completion gates, a CLI, ten bundled skills, and paired skill-evolution evaluation.
description.zh: 科研工作台：提供证据约束的发现记录、守卫收据、完成门禁、CLI、十个内置技能与配对技能进化评估。

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: Summarizes WeChat and QQ chats into a DSH panel for tasks, opportunities, and updates, with links back to the source. One resident session refreshes the panel…
description.zh: 将微信与 QQ 聊天整理为 DSH 面板中的待办、报名机会和资讯，并附原文链接。一个常驻会话按计划或按需刷新面板。可选的聊天导入功能需要另行安装工具。

description.en: Finds lessons recorded in earlier projects and uses an Ollama-compatible model to judge whether to inject a short note before the next agent step. Reads the…
description.zh: 从以往项目的记忆中查找相关经验，由 Ollama 兼容模型判断是否在下一步前插入简短提示。读取 dsh-mnemon 记忆库；可选的 mnemon CLI 提供语义检索。

description.en: Syncs the DSH home directory and Mnemon memory data through a git remote: pull, push, sync on an interval, cross-device migration, initialization backups, and…
description.zh: 通过一个 git 远端同步 DSH 主目录与 Mnemon 记忆数据：拉取、推送、按间隔自动同步、跨设备迁移、初始化备份，遇冲突在推送前停下并保留本地提交；面板记录最近 100 次操作各自的备份路径。

description.en: Fetches Tsinghua MadModel API tokens and attempts to renew them from the saved SSO session on a 20-minute timer in a windowless browser, writes the token into…
description.zh: 获取清华 MadModel 的 API token，按每 20 分钟在无窗口浏览器里用已保存的 SSO 会话尝试续期，写入 DSH 凭据 MADMODEL_API_KEY 并创建或复用 madmodel 模型 Provider；手动点一次 Get 就通过校内登录窗口捕获该会话。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and usage monitor for DSH: a corner widget showing topped-up balance, per-model period consumption, token breakdown, and a Beijing-time…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额与用量监控：右下角悬浮组件，显示充值余额、按模型的周期消耗、Token 明细，以及北京时间高峰/低谷价格提醒；需先在设置里填入 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one…
description.zh: 平级对话之间的通道：经用户授权、对称，授权跨重启保留；忙时多条消息合并成一批按发送时间排序投递。

description.en: Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card…
description.zh: Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。

description.en: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Cursor 侧边栏，支持文件浏览、代码编辑、Git 差异、终端、侧边对话及 Ctrl+L 文件引用。

description.en: Agent preset plus a router plugin: plan mode runs the native tool catalog, and approval switches the session back to stock PTC (run_code only), so plan review…
description.zh: Agent 预设 + 路由插件：计划阶段使用原生工具，批准后把会话切回原始 PTC（只剩 run_code），让计划审批不再受程序预算约束。

description.en: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily…
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具注册免密钥搜索提供方：无需 API Key 即可使用，在 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 官方免密钥通道之间自动降级；若设置了 TAVILY_API_KEY 或 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 会自动采用。另含两个 Bing 抓取后端，默认关闭。

description.en: Paints a colored counter badge (green = unread completed sessions, orange = pending question or approval) on the DeepSeek Harness taskbar icon on Windows, and…
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏的 DeepSeek Harness 图标上叠画彩色计数角标（绿=未读的已完成会话，橙=待回答提问或待批准权限），会话结束时播放提示音。基于 dthcle/dsh-badge-notify（MIT）二次开发，新增提示音与绿/橙状态色；两者都在同一个任务栏图标上叠画角标，不能同时启用。

description.en: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

description.en: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a…
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI on Windows, macOS and Linux: 106 transparent animations in the browser overlay or a transparent always-on-top desktop window,…
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物，Windows / macOS / Linux 三端可用：浏览器浮层或透明置顶桌面窗口，106 个透明动画、带挤压与粒子的甩抛反弹物理、随会话事件实时联动的工作状态气泡、碎碎念与带持久记忆的对话、余额展示、表情包配图、多开同屏，并支持直接放入的自定义动画与宠物种类（pet pack）。

description.en: View and manage an agent’s tools and skills in a visual menu. Set each capability to Resident, On-demand, or Disabled; agents can find and use on-demand…
description.zh: 以可视化菜单查看和管理 Agent 的工具与技能，按常驻、按需、禁用三档控制能力暴露；支持按需检索和使用，减少上下文占用。

description.en: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no…
description.zh: 悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本的真实持仓盈亏，显示今日盈亏、上证指数和当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。

description.en: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可治理 Agent 工作记忆层，沉淀为本地 Markdown 笔记：双模式编辑器（源码⇄富文本，支持图片），约定/资料笔记自动注入系统提示（敏感值自动脱敏），另有快照版本历史、回收站、可撤销归档、AI 整理、双链与全文搜索。兼容 DSH 0.1.7～0.2.x。

description.en: Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, file-level…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话任务看板：主窗口把任务派发给一次性 Worker/Verifier 子代理执行与验收，支持依赖调度、文件级排他锁、裁决挂起冻结、里程碑进展上报与任务级 Token 消耗统计。

description.en: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export,…
description.zh: 编程学习悬浮面板：编辑并运行 Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell（含退出码与耗时），JSON 课程包关卡自动评判并可导出进度，提供 Markdown 笔记与代码片段库；代码分析以用户消息直投当前对话，由对话主模型直接输出。

description.en: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2…
description.zh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

description.en: Composer enhancement: put images or files where you mean them and the model reads each one at that exact position.
description.zh: 输入框增强：把图片或文件放在你想要的位置，模型就在该位置读到它。

description.en: One-line sidebar badge for OpenCode Go quota (5-hour, weekly and monthly windows), switching to the DeepSeek official balance when that model source is…
description.zh: 侧栏底部的一行小徽标：显示 OpenCode Go 额度（5 小时 / 本周 / 本月窗口），切到 DeepSeek 官方模型时显示余额。只读，无遥测。OpenCode Go 额度需要在 DSH 中配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，或登录 OpenCode Console（会兜底读取其本地凭据文件）；Dee…

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
description.zh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Analyzes usage and cost across models, providers and workspaces over any date range: hourly single-day and daily cross-day trends, a 53-week heatmap, cache-hit…
description.zh: 统一分析多模型、多供应商、多工作区的用量与成本：任意起止日期、单日小时与跨日趋势、53 周热力图、缓存命中与模型/工作区占比，另有请求日志、CSV 导出与可跨会话恢复的持久账本。特点：多维用量分析，模型与工作区洞察，可配置成本与余额，完整历史与增量同步，可审计的日常操作。

description.en: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。

description.en: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing…
description.zh: GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic…
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web…
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: Connects all seven Qwen Token Plan Harness-entitlement MCP services (enhanced search, web fetch, code interpreter, vertical search, image, TTS, ASR) plus the…
description.zh: 一步接全千问 Token Plan 的 7 个 Harness 权益 MCP 服务（联网搜索、网页解析、代码解释器、垂类搜索、图像生成、语音合成、语音识别）与决策模型（qwen_decide），附逐服务开关与实时状态面板。

description.en: Shows and loads Qwen (qianwen*) skills only when the session runs on the Qwen Token Plan CN provider, and hides and blocks them on any other provider.
description.zh: 仅当会话运行在 Qwen Token Plan CN 供应商上时才展示并加载千问（qianwen*）技能，其它供应商下隐藏并禁止加载。

description.en: Reference other conversations from the current one — type @ to attach a session's record, drag a sidebar conversation into the composer, or open any…
description.zh: 在当前对话里引用别的对话：输入 @ 附加某段对话的记录，从左侧栏把对话拖进输入框，或打开任意对话、勾选其中几条消息插入到另一个对话中。

description.en: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web into structured Obsidian notes via plugin parsers, MapReduce parallel deep-read subagents, JSON…
description.zh: DSH 精读与摘要：书籍/论文/视频/网页经可插拔解析器转成结构化 Obsidian 笔记，MapReduce 并行精读子代理、JSON Schema 输出与幂等缓存。

description.en: Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with…
description.zh: DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。

description.en: Voice input for the DSH web UI: tap or hold Alt to dictate into the composer. Local SenseVoice ASR by default — offline, zero config, zero key; auto-fallback…
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的语音输入插件：点按或按住 Alt 听写，结果落进输入框草稿。默认本地离线 SenseVoice（离线、零配置、零 key），自动回退浏览器 Web Speech，可选 OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR 服务链，可经 DSH 已配置模型润色，带设置页。

description.en: Adds an Estela view beside Chat and Trajectory that reads the current session log from disk: the ledger, what the model saw at a request, a context compare,…
description.zh: 在 Chat 和 Trajectory 旁增加 Estela 视图，从磁盘读取当前会话日志：事件列表、模型在某次请求看到的内容、上下文对比、上下文压缩移除的内容和按目录价计算的费用。

description.en: Accounts-payable three-way match: import invoices, purchase orders and goods receipts, apply the tolerance policy and export the exception workpaper — 4 `ap.*`…
description.zh: 应付三单匹配：导入发票、采购订单与收货单，按容差策略匹配并导出异常底稿——4 个 `ap.*` 工具。

description.en: Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check: deterministic findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 水产养殖投入品记录完整性与休药期日期核对：按规则 ID 输出确定性发现。

description.en: Turn accounts-receivable detail CSV into an aging table: buckets, per-customer totals, overdue ratio, top overdue customers and CSV export.
description.zh: 把应收明细 CSV 变成账龄表：分桶、客户汇总、逾期占比、Top 逾期客户，再导出 CSV。

description.en: Turn accounts-receivable detail into a prioritized collection plan, reminder-letter drafts and a collection CSV, computed locally.
description.zh: 把应收明细变成按优先级排好的催收计划、催收函草稿和催收清单 CSV，全程本地计算。

description.en: Archive registration checklist for DeepSeek Harness: check archive registration entries against the Rules for the Arrangement of Archived Documents and the…
description.zh: 归档登记表核对：依据《归档文件整理规则》《机关文件材料归档范围和文书档案保管期限规定》（DA/T 22—2015、国务院令第772号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。

description.en: Reconcile a punch-in CSV into per-person daily hours, overtime, over-limit days, missing punches and rest shortfalls, with a monthly summary and CSV export.
description.zh: 把打卡明细 CSV 核对成每人的日工时、加班、超限日、缺卡与休息不足，按月汇总并导出核对表。

description.en: Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by…
description.zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and…
description.zh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time,…
description.zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

description.en: Bank statement reconciliation: ingest CAMT.053 and MT940, match them against ledger entries and export the workpaper — 6 `bankrec.*` tools.
description.zh: 银行对账单核对：导入 CAMT.053 与 MT940，与账簿条目匹配并导出工作底稿——6 个 `bankrec.*` 工具。

description.en: Bid compliance response ledger check for DeepSeek Harness: check compliance response entries against the PRC Bidding Law and its Implementing Regulations…
description.zh: 投标符合性响应台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》（1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正、国务院令第613号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。

description.en: Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located. It…
description.zh: 按招标要求逐条检查投标文件的响应位置，报告哪些要求看起来有应答、哪些匹配较弱、哪些未能定位。只报告差异，不判断是否实质满足。

description.en: Bidder qualification checklist for DeepSeek Harness: check bidder qualification items against the PRC Bidding Law and its Implementing Regulations (adopted…
description.zh: 投标人资格条件核对表：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》（1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正、国务院令第613号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。

description.en: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions,…
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 瀑布上做按插件粒度的用量预算与费用上限：按模型用量记账、会话与月度预算的预警/阻断、延迟窗口与碳足迹估算。

description.en: Checks a canteen food-retention ledger for the four required record elements, the 125 g minimum, the 48-hour cold-storage window and template placeholders left…
description.zh: 核对食堂留样台账的四个记录要素、125 克下限、48 小时冷藏窗口，以及单元格中残留的模板占位符。

description.en: Read-only MCP server over the DSH plugin-certification registry, exposing a plugin certification grade, its snapshot and the five-dimension evidence behind it.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 插件认证登记的只读 MCP 服务，对外提供插件的认证等级、其快照以及支撑它的五维证据。

description.en: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

description.en: Verify that a citation exists and that its metadata is right for DeepSeek Harness: DOI/PMID/arXiv/BibTeX resolution through Crossref, PubMed and arXiv,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 核对引文是否存在、元数据是否正确：经 Crossref、PubMed、arXiv 解析 DOI、PMID、arXiv 与 BibTeX，逐字段比较元数据，并生成 REP v1 证据记录。

description.en: Deterministic claim support checking for DeepSeek Harness: verbatim quote spans, number matching, labelled-value contradiction, negation and hedging polarity…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性论断支撑检查：逐字引文区间、数字匹配、带标签数值矛盾、对被引句的否定与模糊语气极性判断，输出 REP v1 证据/论断/裁决记录和 SARIF。改写式转述只会被报告为“不足”，绝不判为“已支撑”。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard…
description.zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action,…
description.zh: Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。

description.en: Diagnostics, recovery and readiness checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件的诊断、恢复与就绪检查。

description.en: Migration codemods for DeepSeek Harness plugin APIs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件 API 的迁移 codemod。

description.en: A compaction scheduler for DeepSeek Harness: it cuts the tail of a conversation before the official compaction threshold, and every cut has to clear measured…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的压缩调度：在官方压缩阈值之前先切会话尾巴，每一刀都要过「净收益 + 回本轮数」两道门槛，把官方整段摘要推迟到一条可配置的启用线；会话里的「压缩」页签显示每一刀省了多少、缓存重算了多少、下一刀什么时候该出。

description.en: Completion gate for CodeBuddy: when a turn changed code files but ran no test, type check or syntax check, one reminder reaches the model at its next step —…
description.zh: 完成闸门：一个 turn 里改过代码文件、却一次测试/类型检查/语法检查都没跑时，它在模型下一步的上下文里塞一条提醒 —— 去跑一下，或者用具体理由申报豁免。只提醒不阻断，文档改动不算，测试跑挂了也算验证过；agent/pre-step 不带 agent 身份，所以如实使用单账本，不假装按 agent 隔离。

description.en: Novel writing panel for the DSH sidebar that binds a local manuscript folder, imports Agent Skills as analysis lenses, and scans platform rankings into…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的小说创作面板：绑定本地书稿目录，把导入的 Agent 技能当作分析视角，并扫描平台榜单归纳故事架构。

description.en: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone…

description.en: A read-only Agent Team board viewer for DeepSeek Harness: kanban columns in the right sidebar follow task status, a task dialog shows the timeline,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent Team 只读看板：右侧边栏按任务状态显示列，任务对话框展示时间线、依赖与写入范围，代理树按状态分组并显示运行时长、Token、Agent 小时与费用，代理对话框中列出该代理启动的后台进程。

description.en: US stock quotes, price history, financial statements, analyst consensus and news via yahoo-finance2.
description.zh: 美股行情、历史 K 线、财务报表、分析师共识与新闻，数据来自 yahoo-finance2。

description.en: Replace the system prompt sections, runtime context, automatically injected messages, and tool definitions built into DSH with Chinese.
description.zh: 替换DSH内置的系统提示词sections、运行时上下文、自动注入消息与工具定义为中文。

description.en: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话标题从一句话精简为不含动词的短语，目标五个词以内。

description.en: Replaces the composer model picker with a model + thinking-effort picker: arrow keys left/right cycle the effort level and arrow keys up/down switch model; an…

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an…

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never…

description.zh: DSH 音频工具：查看音频/视频信息、转码、从视频提取音轨、裁剪与响度归一化，并用本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口把语音转成文字和字幕。需要本机已装 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe（插件不自带）；本地转写还需 whisper-cli 与 ggml 模型。

description.en: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.

description.en: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a…

description.zh: 当前会话的技能中心面板：列出可见技能及其提供方与来源根目录，阅读 SKILL.md，开关模型/用户调用，并可创建、软删除技能；随包附带 skill-authoring 技能与 skill_create 工具。

description.zh: 接入 Knowra 托管 MCP：无需账号即可按主题、作者或精确 UTC 日期检索 arXiv 论文；在插件页用 OAuth 登录后可读取 Scout 报告（方法、证据与局限）。

description.en: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
description.zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

description.en: Recommends up to ten GitHub repositories daily with a configurable count and saves selected repositories to categorized Markdown.
description.zh: 每天按配置推荐最多 10 个 GitHub 仓库，支持将选中的仓库按分类保存到 Markdown。

description.en: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and…

description.en: Right-sidebar basket that collects the files a session produced or changed without the agent having to register them, with preview, zip packaging, and…

description.en: Read-only monitor for local DSH sessions: live task board, per-session tails, blocking reply wait, Markdown export, and optional IM push via dsh-im. Requires…

description.en: Claude-style palette and typography for the DSH Web GUI — paper-white surface, near-black ink and terracotta accent derived from the Codex absolutely theme,…

description.en: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F…

description.en: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 让对话框中普通 Enter 换行、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交，可在设置中开关。

description.en: Lets a text-only agent watch a live screen or camera feed: every frame is scored by how much the picture changed, only the ones that matter are packed into one…
