description.en: QQ tools for DSH with group and private messaging, chat history, favorite stickers, pokes, friend management, and Qzone integration. Requires SnowLuma.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 QQ 群聊与私聊收发、聊天记录、收藏表情、戳一戳、好友管理和 QQ 空间功能，仅支持 SnowLuma。

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection…
description.zh: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

description.en: A separate session-group board opened from a sidebar row: custom groups with drag-and-drop cards, five cards by two rows per page with a pager, group-local pin…
description.zh: 侧栏新增「会话分组」看板：自定义分组、拖动卡片换组；每组 5 列 × 2 行分页，超出可翻页；置顶决定组内排序；会话行显示分组色点、悬停卡片显示分组名、右键菜单可「归入分组」。只往内置侧栏上加位置，不替换侧栏；分组数据存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Windows-only derivative of the official ego lite DSH plugin (@ego-lite/dsh-plugin, citrolabs/ego-lite) that cannot be installed alongside it: connects DeepSeek…
description.zh: ego lite 官方 DSH 插件（@ego-lite/dsh-plugin，citrolabs/ego-lite）的 Windows 衍生版，不能与官方插件同装：通过带认证的本机 HTTP 连接已安装的 Windows ego lite，提供任务空间、导航、页面读取、点击、表单输入和截图。

description.en: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to…
description.zh: 乔哈里认知四象限对话梳理工具——在输入框上方添加按钮，弹出 2×2 象限面板（我知道/不知道 × AI知道/不知道），将对话上下文梳理为结构化 Prompt 并写回输入框。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own…
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle…

description.en: Local knowledge base and document search for DeepSeek Harness with full-text search, PDF/Word/PowerPoint/Excel/Markdown import, OCR, ACL, and a Web panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库与文档检索插件：全文搜索、PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/Markdown 导入与按行读取、扫描件 OCR、ACL 和 Web 面板。

description.en: Keep SSH, WSL and Docker projects in the native DSH sidebar. Group directories by environment while choosing full remote DSH or lightweight local Agent mode…
description.zh: 在当前 DSH 窗口的原生侧栏中管理 SSH / WSL / Docker 项目。目录按环境归组，每个项目独立选择全量远程后端或本机 Agent 轻量模式；共享全量连接统一管理，轻量连接独立控制，并可比较、选择性同步本机 Skill。主要面向 Windows 桌面客户端与装有 Python 3、Bash 的…

description.en: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览本地 HTML，点选元素或框选区域写批注，把选中项、当前样式与目标样式一起发进当前会话。

description.en: Visual workflow orchestrator: drag task nodes on a canvas, wire them into sequential, parallel or gateway-joined graphs, and run them; every task node creates…
description.zh: 可视化工作流编排：在画布上拖任务节点、连成串行、并行或网关汇合的工作流后执行；每个任务节点都会创建真实的 DSH 任务会话，判断与终止节点可以让整次运行提前结束。

description.en: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin with quick controls for waves, daylight, glass opacity, and an automatic day cycle.
description.zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，可快捷调节波浪、日光、玻璃不透明度与自动昼夜循环。

description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for dsh: watches your session state and acts it out with rich animations, and levels up as you cultivate.
description.zh: 渡劫飞升：仙逆王林修炼伙伴。实时监控会话状态，用打坐、掐诀、御剑、雷龙等丰富交互动画演绎大模型的每一个动作，随使用修炼升境。

description.en: Ports CSDN blog article typography into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — heading hierarchy, quote blocks, solid-grid tables, inline code and Atom One syntax…
description.zh: 把 CSDN 博文的配色与正文排版搬进 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：标题层级、引用块、实线网格表格、行内代码与 Atom One 语法高亮，浅色深色各一套。

description.en: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore…
description.zh: 某个工作区的未归档会话从 1+ 掉到 0 的那一刻自动隐藏它的侧栏行，并在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」，另配侧栏底部恢复入口。只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区。

description.en: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
description.zh: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

description.en: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step…
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host…

description.en: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec,…
description.zh: 把本机 OpenCLI daemon 当常驻服务直连的 DSH 浏览器工具，替代「每条命令起一次 opencli CLI」的冷启动：oc_status、oc_exec、oc_navigate、oc_snapshot、oc_tabs 五个工具，每个 session 一个常驻自动化标签页。需要本机运行 OpenCLI…

description.en: Save reusable prompt snippets with categories and {{placeholders}}; manage them with /snippet commands (add, list, rm, optimize) and insert into the composer…
description.zh: 保存带分类与 {{占位符}} 的可复用提示词片段：用 /snippet 命令（add/list/rm/optimize）管理，从输入框下方可拖拽面板一键插入草稿，并支持用默认模型一键 AI 优化。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DSH sessions: archives older turns under context pressure, with four tiered hot-memory boards, project documents, trivia notes…
description.zh: DSH 会话的本地长期记忆：上下文压力升高时归档较早轮次，提供四板块分级热记忆、项目档案、不注入的杂事随记、带瞩目等级与同义词扩展的关系图谱、记忆家族与根转移、摘要关键词定位、手动注入、20K 分段读取和 tag 关联检索。数据都保存在工作区。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH…

description.en: Autonomous Douyin watching in a dedicated Edge browser on Windows (requires Node.js 22.13+): sampling decisions, frame storyboards, danmaku-aware comments,…
description.zh: 在 Windows 的专用 Edge 浏览器里自主刷抖音（需 Node.js 22.13+）：采样决策、抽帧拼故事板、带时间的高赞弹幕、人格与兴趣记忆、观看日报，全程受每日时段与额度限制。改自 LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Switch a skill on for every reply in one session at a chosen level, without changing any SKILL.md file.
description.zh: 在会话里把一个技能按选定挡位常驻开启，让每次回答自动生效，且不改动任何 SKILL.md 文件。

description.en: Connects an existing local CodeGraph CLI to each session's indexed project, shares one MCP process per project, and updates session-scoped tools when the…
description.zh: 将本机已安装的 CodeGraph CLI 接入各会话的已索引项目，同项目共享一个 MCP 进程，并在工作目录或索引变化时更新会话级工具。
给 DSH 插件开发准备三件事：重载文件有改动的插件、重载办不到的改动就重启客户端、模型能自己触发热重载。重载走 DSH 自带的路径，没碰过的插件继续运行。重启从客户端外部发起，所以被替换的正是客户端也能完成，有会话或后台任务在跑时拒绝。轻量：不带参数、不添加上下文、按钮默认不出现。
description.en: Three things for DSH plugin development: reload the plugins whose files changed, restart the client when a reload cannot apply a change, and let the model…
Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool;…
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能处理聊天贴图，提供原生视觉体验，支持批量看图，走内置 OpenAI 兼容识图工具 analyze_image；具备视觉能力的模型不受影响。

description.en: Drive the DSH Desktop right-sidebar browser on Windows through playwright-cli, with a stable per-session page ID. Needs DSH started with --remote-debugging-port…
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端通过 playwright-cli 驱动右侧边栏浏览器，为每个会话提供稳定的 pageId。需要用 --remote-debugging-port=0 启动 DSH，并全局安装 @playwright/cli。

description.en: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps,…
description.zh: 把跑着的会话排成一张报纸式头版，作为 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁的 Conversation View 标签页：逐轮时间线（耗时、步数、工具、token、结果）、按文件统计的改动热度、墙钟时间去向以及其中多少是模型而非工具、哪一轮吃掉了花费、无人重试的失败（附失败命令），以及对照该路由模型自报容量的上下文压…

description.en: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows,…
description.zh: 在官方队列 dock 内直接重排忙碌时排队的消息：每一行带拖拽手柄与上下移动按钮，移动在宿主端以一次带并发校验的 inbox splice 完成。只装饰官方 dock 而不替换它，因此预览、行内编辑、插话、删除与附件保持原样。队列已变化、该行不是用户消息（例如目标轮次提示）、或队列属于子代理会话时，移动会被拒绝。

description.en: Shows model provider balances and subscription quotas for DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, StepFun, Novita and Xiaomi MiMo in the DSH sidebar and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏与设置页集中显示 DeepSeek、Kimi、OpenRouter、StepFun、Novita、小米 MiMo 等平台的余额与订阅额度。

description.en: Adds a quick-reply button to the composer toolbar: pick a saved snippet to insert at the cursor, and add, edit or delete replies in the same panel. Replies are…
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏加一个快捷回复按钮：选择一个已保存的片段插入到光标处，并可在同一面板中新增、编辑、删除回复。回复保存在浏览器本地存储中，内容可包含 @dsh-doc 这类技能引用。

description.en: Telegram remote for DeepSeek Harness — attach a live web session from your phone and answer its questions there, with a Russian UI. Russian fork of…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 遥控器：在手机上接续正在运行的 Web 会话并回答问题，界面为俄语。hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel 的俄语分支（MIT）。

description.en: Adds personality injection, a decaying memory card, a mood state and a daily diary so the agent keeps identity and history across sessions.
description.zh: 给 agent 加人格注入、会衰减的记忆卡、心情状态和每日日记，让它跨会话保留身份和历史。

description.en: Connects QQ private chats and groups to DSH over OneBot 11, adding qq_send and other tools so the agent can reply, send stickers and wait for follow-ups.
description.zh: 经 OneBot 11 把 QQ 私聊和群聊接进 DSH，提供 qq_send 等工具，让 agent 能回消息、发表情、等待对方接话。

description.en: Carries a DSH environment between machines through one private GitHub or Gitee repository: third-party plugins (reinstalled from a version, or carried as a…
description.zh: 通过一个私有 GitHub / Gitee 仓库在机器之间搬运 DSH 环境：第三方插件（按版本重装，或携带 tarball / 源码目录）、四个 profile 配置文件、以及文件夹快照。还原时逐文件比对，本机改过的文件不覆盖，被替换的文件先备份，并按绝对路径、已登记的根、或显式确认三级解析落点；逃出根、穿越…

description.en: Fast-execution runtime for dsh: context governance with 4 KB tool-result caps and field projection, zero-LLM fast-path templates with idempotency keys, PTC…
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的快速执行运行时：上下文治理（4 KB 工具返回截断与字段投影）、零 LLM 快路径模板（幂等键）、PTC 容器脚本（中间结果不进上下文）、三级沙箱（文件/命令/网络规则、注入检测、敏感信息脱敏、快照与回收站）与追加式审计日志；10 个 runtime_kit_* 斜杠命令，零业务依赖。

description.en: DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and…
description.zh: 将本机已登录的 AGY CLI 接入 DSH 作为模型 Provider：支持 Gemini/Claude 模型发现、独立推理强度、DSH-owned 工具、受限上下文与工具结果管理、Windows 安全流式传输；如遇问题，请在 GitHub 提交 Issue：https://github.com/darkings/d…

description.en: A DSH-native plugin update center: check and update installed plugins from the sidebar with snapshots, rollback, queued updates and uninstall-leftover cleanup.
description.zh: 尊重 DSH 原始风格的插件更新插件：在侧边栏检查、排队更新已安装插件，支持快照回滚、安装后校验、卸载残留清理与离线恢复。

description.en: A bookshelf panel for reading .txt novels beside the conversation: import a local file, decode UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, UTF-16 or GB18030, split it into…
description.zh: 在对话旁边加一个书架面板，用来读本地 .txt 小说：导入文件后识别 UTF-8、带 BOM 的 UTF-8、UTF-16 或 GB18030 编码并自动分章，提供目录、上下章、字号、行距与版心宽度，每本书从上次读到的章节与位置继续。

description.en: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的审核优先批量自动化：先审核三个样本，预览全部结果，一次批准，再安全地应用到多个文件。

description.en: Performs a mode exchange (mode switch, switch mode) on an existing DSH session: the Agent mode is swapped in place, so the system prompt and toolset change at…
description.zh: 模式交换（也叫模式切换、切换模式）：在已存在的 DSH 会话中就地换掉 Agent 模式，不新建会话，系统提示词与工具集在运行时替换。也可做模式迁移（会话迁移）：按目标模式重建会话并真导入原生事件序列，迁移有幂等台账、可续跑，并生成每次迁移的报告。

description.en: Installs the coaligne-workflow skill for CoAligne team collaboration; requires CoAligne Desktop (signed in) to provide the MCP connection - not usable without…
description.zh: 安装 CoAligne 团队协作的 coaligne-workflow skill；MCP 连接由登录后的 CoAligne Desktop 提供，不安装 Desktop 则无法使用。

description.en: Browse workspace files in a right sidebar tab and add files or selected code lines to the session from context menus, with a line-selectable code preview.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏浏览工作区文件，通过右键菜单把文件或选中的代码行加入会话，代码预览支持按行号选择引用。

description.en: Adds a refresh button and a power menu (restart / close DeepSeek Harness) to the conversation header. Client-only, zero tokens, no dependencies. The power menu…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加一个刷新按钮和一个电源菜单（重启 / 关闭 DeepSeek Harness）。纯客户端、零 token、零依赖。电源菜单目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Adds a per-session notebook with autosave, a draggable key-information panel with collapsible items and queue injection, notebook and key-information…
description.zh: 为每个会话增加自动保存的笔记本和可拖动关键信息面板，面板支持条目折叠与队列注入；原生分叉和 /fork 会继承笔记本与关键信息；另提供工作区会话组、会话高亮、运行工作区置顶与蓝色转圈指示，以及右侧边栏任意标签的关闭当前/左侧/右侧/全部操作。

description.en: Optimize prompts in the DeepSeek Harness composer: identify missing requirements, insert a sentence from 90 method cards, or compare and edit a full rewrite…
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里优化提示词：发现草稿中没说清的要求，从 90 张方法卡中选一句补进去，或对照原稿编辑整段改写。由你决定采用和发送。

description.en: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker…
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

description.en: Adds a Continue button left of the model selector: after a turn ends aborted by the user, interrupted by a crash or errored, one click sends notices asking the…
description.zh: 在模型选择器左侧加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被用户中止、崩溃中断或报错结束后，点一下让模型接着把那一轮做完；开始输入或添加附件时按钮收窄隐藏。

description.en: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid…
description.zh: 单文件本地 SQLite 的自整理活记忆——夜巡引擎自动去重、合并、衰减、建链，七信号 RRF 混合检索（FTS5+jieba 中文优先分词、可选向量 KNN、图谱 PPR），带类型知识图谱，冲突检测标记矛盾而非静默覆写，Web 遥测面板。

description.en: Adds a deep-research agent preset with the DeepSight methodology skill bundled, plus three tools that set an evidence contract, audit claim tiers along the…
description.zh: 新增一个深度研究 Agent 预设，内置 DeepSight 方法论技能；另附三个工具，分别用于设定证据契约、沿行动依据的来源链审计结论档位、汇总已落盘账本。行动依据若源自未验证估算或尚未闭环的冲突，交付会被拦截。

description.en: Denies agent-issued delete commands and redirects them to a file_trash tool that moves the target into the Windows Recycle Bin; refuses an in-place rewrite of…
description.zh: 拦截 agent 的删除命令，改为经 file_trash 工具移入 Windows 回收站；拒绝“读改写同一文件”，共享删除先复制到本地 NTFS 卷、校验并回收副本后再删原件。

description.en: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster…

description.en: Attaches the current Chrome tab to a DSH draft: one pick screenshots the page (falling back to a macOS window shot) and writes its title and URL into the…

description.en: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual…

description.en: A learning chat tree for branching chat: fork selected text with inherited context, continue each native session, and return to your reading position.

description.en: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.zh: DSH 项目初始化脚手架预设：严格 5 阶段初始化流程 + 工程规范 + 六套可运行模板（node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo）。

description.en: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged…

description.en: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs…
description.zh: 只读仓库事实扫描内核：为分析型插件提供可复现的仓库探测、文件索引、模块、依赖、入口、符号与 Git 变更等硬事实（CLI + 库接口 + 技能 runbook）。

description.en: Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.

description.en: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.
description.zh: Android Studio 风格 ADB logcat 查看器，支持实时过滤与等级配色。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

description.en: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of…
description.zh: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

description.en: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and…

description.en: One panel for MCP servers, skills and Claude Code plugins across global/profile/project scopes: live status, import/export, trash & backups, and the official…

description.en: Pins your DeepSeek Harness account balance to the bottom-right corner and refreshes it every 60 seconds, with a click for an immediate lookup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 主界面右下角常驻账户余额，60 秒自动刷新，点击即可立即查询。

description.en: Phone access to a local DeepSeek Harness through a relay you run: QR pairing, request payloads sealed end to end, and a host machine that opens no inbound port.
description.zh: 通过自建中继从手机访问本机的 DeepSeek Harness：扫码配对、请求载荷端到端加密、本机无需开放入站端口。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool…
description.zh: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

description.en: Workspace pinning plugin with an effect close to the built-in session pin.
description.zh: 实现了接近官方会话置顶效果的工作区置顶插件。

description.en: Adds an on-demand coding-guidelines skill covering assumptions and tradeoffs, simplicity, surgical changes, and verifiable goals, adapted from Andrej…
description.zh: 提供按需加载的编码准则技能：先想再写、保持简单、外科手术式修改、以可验证目标推进，源自 Andrej Karpathy 对 LLM 编码陷阱的观察。

description.zh: DSH 重启后唤醒主 agent，让被打断的工作自动接着做；提供一个重启工具，以及可选的探针在启动异常时提前中止并告警。

description.en: Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own,…

description.en: Opens the official Plannotator app (plannotator.ai) so you can review the agent's plan — annotate, approve, or send it back.
description.zh: 打开官方 Plannotator 应用（plannotator.ai）审代理写好的计划：批注、批准，或打回重写。

description.en: Manage MCP servers across local AI agents from one panel — read and edit DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and WorkBuddy configs with automatic backups and…

description.zh: 在同一会话里对比两三次回答，并从之后每次模型请求中剔除指定的轮次。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness control center for official balance monitoring, per-session costs and tokens, third-party token totals, completion alerts, official recharge,…

description.en: Adds six animated conversation backgrounds, selectable accent colors, and outline or duotone icons to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六种动态会话背景，可自选强调色并切换线描或双色图标。

description.en: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a clearer, first-person version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted…
description.zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话改写成更清晰、以第一人称表达的版本，更容易得到好答案；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，缺的信息用占位符标出而不乱猜，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

description.en: Inline annotations for DeepSeek Harness replies and sidebar documents, with a composer card and a right-sidebar list.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回复和侧边栏文档加划词标注，聚合成输入框卡片并一键发给 AI，右侧边栏可查看列表。

description.en: A local life-management workspace with tasks, planning, finance, lists and inventory, habit check-ins, an inspiration library and reviews; data stays in a…
description.zh: 本地生活管理工作台：任务、规划、财务记账、清单与物资、习惯打卡、灵感库、复盘八个模块，数据以本地 JSON 保存。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Edit Markdown right in the sidebar preview — click a block to edit it in place, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter writes it back to the file, and the built-in read-only view stays…
description.zh: 在右侧边栏的 Markdown 预览里直接编辑：点文本块就地改，⌘/Ctrl+Enter 保存写回文件；随时可切回内置只读渲染。

description.en: Search skills by their Chinese name inside the `/` menu and insert the real English skill name (for example `/与神对话` → `ff-yushen-duihua`).
description.zh: 在 `/` 菜单里按中文技能名搜索：输入 `/与神对话` 命中 `ff-yushen-duihua`，选中插入真实英文技能名。

description.en: Two global skins (warm paper, ink charcoal) switched from Settings → General; colour tokens only, with layout and features untouched and an off switch back to…
description.zh: 两套全局皮肤（暖纸象牙白 / 墨暖炭黑），开关在「设置 → 通用 → 皮肤」；只改颜色变量，不动布局、字号与功能，关掉即回官方外观。

description.en: Unread awareness — a Dock badge count for replies you have not opened, plus one coloured dot per workspace row (red error, green unread, blue running) that…
description.zh: 未读提醒：Dock 图标数字角标，加上工作区标题行的彩色点（红=出错、绿=完成未读、蓝=运行中），折叠也可见；不出声，可与通知类插件共存。

description.en: Play local video and audio inside the sidebar preview — HTTP Range streaming keeps memory flat at any file size, nothing buffers until you press play, playback…
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接播放本地视频与音频：HTTP Range 流式读取让内存不随文件变大、不点播放不缓冲、侧边栏收起即暂停；浏览器解不了的格式一键交给本机播放器。

description.en: Persona mode + structured output for DSH: identity header, three cards and signature rendered by the plugin while the model only submits a persona JSON…
description.zh: DSH 人格模式 + 结构化输出：身份头 / 三卡 / 收尾由插件渲染，模型只交 persona 内容块；人格默认开启、可显式关闭，结构化按会话开关。

description.en: Registers the locally installed Oh My Pi CLI (omp) as a DSH subagent backend: every delegation runs one `omp --print --mode json` process that inherits your…
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 Oh My Pi CLI（omp）注册为 DSH 子代理后端：每次委派跑一个 omp --print --mode json 进程，模型与供应商沿用你自己的 ~/.omp 配置，串行排队，不会把单会话的本地引擎压垮。需先安装并配置 omp。

description.en: AlertManager panel in the DSH sidebar: reads multiple AlertManager HTTP API v2 instances in parallel, aggregates their alerts into severity-colored cards…
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的 AlertManager 告警面板：并行读取多个 AlertManager HTTP API v2 实例，把告警聚合为可按搜索 / 状态 / 级别 / 实例筛选的严重度卡片；勾选任意告警并选择工作区后一键新建会话，把按实例分组的告警作为首条消息发给 agent 立即处理。支持每实例独立鉴权与…

description.en: Highlights answered ask blocks (the “question n/n answered” tool rows) in the conversation with a soft brand-tinted card that follows the light/dark theme;…
description.zh: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和品牌色卡片凸显，明暗主题自适应；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样。设置页可开关「高亮已答复提问块」与「默认展开」。

description.en: External @ file references: extends the Web GUI `@` completion so it can browse and reference absolute-path files and directories outside the workspace, level…
description.zh: @ 文件引用增强：扩展 Web GUI 的 `@` 补全，使其可逐级浏览并引用工作区外的任意绝对路径文件 / 目录（`@/`、`@~/`），选中后插入绝对路径（含空格时自动加引号）供模型读取。可在「设置 → 插件」中开关，关闭后与原生补全一致。默认开启，模型对这些路径的读取不受沙箱限制；只支持 POSIX…

description.en: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway (optional HTTPS via your own certificate or a self-signed local CA) for LAN and remote access without…
description.zh: DSH 增强套件：为 Web GUI 提供独立的密码访问网关（可选 HTTPS，支持上传证书或由插件自签发本地 CA），无需 `?token=` 即可在局域网 / 远程登录；整合 PWA 安装与应用名 / 图标、桌面通知与手机 Web Push（任务完成、等待审批等事件），并可选地把当前会话的 session id…

description.en: Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode for non-destructive…
description.zh: 进入计划模式工具：给模型一个可调用的 `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode`，把当前会话切进计划模式先做非破坏性探索，再配合内置的 `exit_plan_mode` 提交方案评审。无设置项。

description.en: After you approve a plan review, automatically close every plan tab of that session in the right sidebar, including tabs left by earlier revision rounds.
description.zh: 点「同意执行」批准计划、计划模式退出后，自动关闭该会话右侧边栏里的全部计划标签页，含多轮修订留下的多个。

description.en: PWA icon: replaces the icon and app name used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop, covering desktop browsers and the iOS home screen. Ships a…
description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装 / 添加到桌面时使用的图标与应用名换成自定义内容，覆盖桌面浏览器与 iOS 主屏幕。包内自带开箱即用的图标集，也支持换成自己的图片并覆盖 manifest 字段。

description.en: Portrait layout for desktop windows: when the browser window is portrait, navigation takes the full left column and the file/terminal panel moves to the upper…
description.zh: 竖屏布局（仅电脑窗口）：浏览器窗口为竖屏时，左侧导航占整列，文件 / 终端面板移到对话区上方（右上），中间分隔线可拖拽调整高度（初始高度可配）。手机 / 平板不受影响。

description.en: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面动态壁纸插件：支持 GIF / 动图 WebP / APNG 与静态 PNG/JPG 图片，以及 MP4 / WebM 视频背景，格式自动识别，自带压暗与亮度调节，可让界面色调跟随背景。

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row…
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.
description.zh: 经典麦金塔 System 7 像素风主题：桌面网点画布、Finder 侧栏、黑白按钮与弹窗，深浅色随官方外观切换。

description.en: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action…
description.zh: 会话页里多出一个 Git 页；左侧是未暂存 / 已暂存的改动，右侧是带行级操作条（暂存 / 丢弃）的 diff 预览。

description.en: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
description.zh: DSH Web 本地离线语音输入：麦克风经本地 FunASR（SenseVoiceSmall）识别后填入输入框，支持一键安装，全程离线。

description.en: Manage relay day cards from the DSH sidebar. Paste a seller delivery message to write the model route and store the API key, then see per-card token usage, an…
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏管理中转站日卡。粘贴发货信息即可写入模型路由并保存密钥，随后按卡查看 token 用量、到期倒计时和对照官方价的费用，并一键修复上下文窗口导致的输出截断。

description.en: One leader, many sessions: tell the leader the goal and it splits the work into cards, runs persistent worker sessions in the background, collects their…
description.zh: 一个 leader 管多个 session：把目标告诉 leader，它拆成卡片、在后台跑常驻 worker 会话、收齐各自回报，任务事实落在右侧栏的按项目看板——几个 feature 并行推进，而不是逐个陪跑。项目级 LEADER.md 与 SLOTS.md 塑造每次请求的行为，`read_worker_sessio…

description.en: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify…
description.zh: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。

description.en: GIS/CAD analysis toolkit for dsh: read DXF, convert DWG to DXF, query layers/entities, export styled analysis maps (SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF, plus PSD on Windows x64),…
description.zh: 面向规划/测绘的 GIS/CAD 分析工具：读 DXF、DWG 转 DXF、按图层/文字查实体、出带版式的分析图（SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF，PSD 仅 Windows x64），并对 SHP/GeoJSON/KML 做按类汇总、缓冲与叠加——解析用纯 JS，不依赖 GDAL。

description.en: Codex-style left sidebar for the dsh web client: a project/session tree with grouping, pinning, drag reordering, unread and archive state, context menus for…
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端的 Codex 风格左侧边栏：项目/会话树，支持分组、置顶、拖拽排序、未读与归档状态，项目行与会话行都有右键菜单；输入框按上下方向键可召回之前发送过的消息。

description.en: IDE tab in the dsh web client: a Monaco editor with the Dark Modern theme plus a file tree, git source control (stage/commit/push), an integrated xterm…
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端里的 IDE 标签页：Dark Modern 主题的 Monaco 编辑器，配文件树、Git 源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送）、xterm 集成终端与 ripgrep 全工作区搜索，作为会话视图标签打开。

description.en: VS Code tabs for the dsh web client: one after the chat view and one in the right sidebar, both an embedded code-server workbench on the current session's…
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端的 VS Code 标签页：会话视图里（对话之后）和右侧栏各一个，内嵌 code-server 工作区，工作区跟随当前会话目录；iframe 挂载在 React 之外，切走只是隐藏、切回不重载，每个会话在 127.0.0.1 上独享一个免认证的 code-server 进程；未安装…

description.en: Update checker and installer companion for third-party DSH plugins with startup sidebar and row badges that reconcile after native updates, concurrent CDN…
description.zh: 第三方 DSH 插件检查与更新增强工具，启动后台探测并在侧边栏与已安装列表展示更新角标（原生弹窗更新完成后自动同步消隐），支持 GitHub 仓库及分支/标签（#ref）、固定 commit 解锁与 monorepo 子路径的 CDN 并发竞速检测与升级，提供 npm/npmmirror/自定义源切换与官方源回退、mi…

description.en: Memory Palace, a reading workspace that places books (PDF, EPUB), Bilibili video courses and notes on a grid, tracks reading progress, keeps excerpts, thoughts…
description.zh: Memory Palace 读书插件：把书（PDF、EPUB）、B 站视频课和笔记放进格子宫殿，记录读书进度、摘录、想法和错题，并把 AI 对话总结存成灵感。

description.en: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; Tab accepts it, ↓ generates the next…
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测用户的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里；Tab 采纳、↓ 生成下一条、↑ 回到上一条、Esc 忽略。每次助手回复后会额外调用一次会话所用的模型，带上最近的用户与助手文本。

description.en: Registers the REA reverse-engineering toolset in DSH and manages its Node and REA runtime, with a global tool switch, a live composer status indicator and…
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向分析工具集接入 DSH，并托管其 Node 与 REA 运行时：提供全局工具开关、输入框状态指示点和就地运行时升级。首次启动会从 nodejs.org 和 npm 下载固定版本的 Node 与 REA 运行时到受管目录，并把 REA 的全部工具注册为 mcp__rea__*；可选的分析器只在你要求时才配…

description.en: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency…
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一层点阵背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼剪影,或导入透明 PNG 按 alpha 取主体;每颗粒子各自持有低频外力,手动模式下跟随光标扰动,自动屏保模式则用 360° 任意方向的扫波与全屏呼吸带动整幅图案;鼠标/自动与鲸鱼/照片在参数面板里切换,入口在 设置 → 插件。

description.en: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自适应拓扑多智能体预设，提供点对点通信、任务交接和实时网络可视化。

description.en: MiniMax H3-Image text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing inside DSH, using your own MINIMAX_API_KEY.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 MiniMax H3-Image 文生图与图生图，使用你自己的 MINIMAX_API_KEY。

description.en: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for Odoo: 15 tools take a request from an immutable spec through architecture to module code or live configuration, then…
description.zh: 面向 Odoo 的规范驱动开发流水线：15 个工具把需求从不可变规范推进到架构、再到模块代码或线上配置，最终要求一个由真实 Odoo 实例证据支撑的持久判定；闸门 fail-closed，批量操作需在声明的环境中经人工批准，复用 Odoo 自带的 CSV／Excel 导入器，并有一份可回滚本插件所写数据的日志。

description.en: Draw paper figures as SVG the way top venues draw them, lint them against layout rules, edit them on a sidebar canvas, and export vector PDF or editable…
description.zh: 把论文里的想法画成顶会风格的 SVG 插图，按排版规矩自动体检，在侧栏画布上直接改，最后导出矢量 PDF 与可编辑 draw.io。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Windows sandbox for DSH Desktop: process isolation, permission controls, selected-file protection against accidental deletion, privacy and system security.…
description.zh: Windows x64 安全沙箱，为 DSH Desktop 提供安全防护、进程隔离和权限控制。文件保护、目录保护：防误删，限制指定目录的读取、覆盖与删除；隐私保护：限制截屏、录屏、摄像头和麦克风访问；系统保护：约束进程、服务、注册表及桌面干扰。FinShield 首次启用需下载原生组件并经 Windows…

description.en: Plays a two-note bell when the current turn ends and two quick beeps when an approval or a question needs an answer, for the conversation in the main view.
description.zh: 本轮结束响两声上行铃音，出现审批或提问响两声短促蜂鸣，只跟随主视图中的对话。

description.en: Bridges the Cua Driver MCP server into DSH: installs the cua-driver executable when it is missing, starts it over stdio through the in-box MCP client, and…
description.zh: 把 Cua Driver 的 MCP 服务器接入 DSH：缺失时自动安装 cua-driver，经内置 MCP 客户端以 stdio 启动，注册其 60 个无障碍优先的窗口、输入、菜单与浏览器工具，并附带工作流技能与一次性的 macOS 权限引导。

description.en: Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to…
description.zh: 需 macOS 与支持头部追踪的 AirPods。戴着 AirPods 用点头/摇头回答 DSH 的权限许可与提问——点头＝允许或确认，摇头＝拒绝或切换选项；会话里一张卡片就能装好配套的 macOS 菜单栏 App。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3…
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: Windows file search + document full-text search: names via Everything (es.exe), text inside PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/EPUB via Anytxt; both installed separately.
description.zh: 本机文件搜索与文档全文搜索（全文检索）：文件名走 Everything（es.exe），磁盘上的 PDF / DOCX / XLSX / PPTX / EPUB 正文走 Anytxt，五个只读工具；两个引擎需另装，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: QA pipeline as 10 agent skills: requirement analysis, test strategy, case writing and review, E2E (Playwright) and API automation, exploratory, regression…
description.zh: 软件测试全流程技能包：10 个技能覆盖需求分析、测试策略、用例编写与审查、E2E（Playwright）与 API 自动化、探索式测试、回归范围与 Bug 分析，共享知识库提供格式规范、风险模型与 Schema 校验脚本。

description.en: Console for self-hosted task panels (Qinglong and Daidai) in the sidebar: manage panel connections, environment variables and scheduled tasks over each panel's…
description.zh: 在侧栏管理自托管定时面板（青龙 / 呆呆）：用面板的 OpenAPI 应用凭据管理连接、环境变量与定时任务，权限探测结果落库，其余资源由四个智能体工具完成。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation…
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Real-time captions: recognise system audio and the microphone, bilingual subtitles, translation between many languages, and meeting minutes in one click.
description.zh: 实时字幕：识别系统声音和麦克风，支持双语字幕，多种语言互译，一键生成会议纪要。

description.en: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero…
description.zh: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Full-screen workspace panel for DSH: a project sidebar with per-project tabs for session, files, explorer, project search, terminal, browser, source control…
description.zh: DSH 全屏工作台面板：项目侧栏加按项目隔离的 tab，覆盖会话、文件、资源管理器、全项目搜索、终端、浏览器、源代码管理与 Markdown 笔记库。

description.en: Automatic approval and audit frame for DSH tool calls: a four-outcome rule table (deny, ask, AI review, allow) over commands, file access, network and tool…

description.en: Host-side TTS bridge for dsh that synthesizes speech over the Edge TTS protocol and serves MP3 on a same-origin route, for containers with no audio device.

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: SSH remote workspaces for DSH with parallel projects across hosts, file browsing and editing, recursive search, terminals, Git diffs, and Agent tools to edit,…
description.zh: DSH 的 SSH 远程工作区：多主机项目并行、文件浏览与编辑、递归搜索、终端、Git 差异，以及 Agent 远程编辑、构建与测试；可选 IDE 布局。

description.en: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing,…

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free…

description.en: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English…

description.en: Multi-source image search and download (14 engines + 7 aliases covering Baidu, Bing, 360, Duitang, Huaban, Iconify, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Openverse, Wikimedia,…
description.zh: 多图源搜图并下载（14 个图源 + 7 个别名，覆盖百度/必应/360/堆糖/花瓣/Iconify/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/维基共享/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru），落盘进会话工作区并逐张写 meta.json，图片直接在对话里显示；另附独立…

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool…
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: Double-press ArrowUp/ArrowDown in the DSH Web composer to recall this session's sent messages, and restore your draft when you move past the newest one.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框快速连按两次 ↑/↓ 回溯本会话已发送的消息，越过最新一条时恢复草稿。

description.en: Native inline media player for the dsh web chat: the media_show tool mints short-lived host-served URLs and the client renders playable cards for mp4, webm,…
description.zh: DSH Web 对话里的原生内联媒体播放器：media_show 工具签发短时效本地链接，客户端直接渲染可播放卡片，支持 mp4、webm、gif 与动图 webp，生成的视频在会话内播放。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness eyes and hands on a Windows desktop: eight MCP tools cover screen capture, mouse and keyboard input, window and process control, files,…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上 Windows 桌面的眼睛和手：8 个 MCP 工具覆盖截屏、鼠标键盘、窗口与进程、文件、注册表、PowerShell、剪贴板、虚拟桌面与独立子会话，另附一份教模型按什么顺序调用它们的技能。

description.en: Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.

description.en: An editable diagram canvas in the DSH sidebar plus two agent tools (diagram_read, diagram_apply) that read and edit the workspace in place, using native…

description.en: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.

description.en: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

description.en: Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind…

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over…

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the…

description.en: Runs local CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Pi by default, auto-detected) as panels inside DSH, reusing the official subprocess.spawnTerminal…

description.en: Overrides the order, names and icons of DeepSeek Harness settings navigation entries from a personal profile configuration, without patching other plugins.…

description.en: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的设置弹窗以整页全屏打开，并把退出入口移到左上角的返回行。

description.en: Command Code balance and quota panel: a status row under the composer showing the available balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.
description.zh: Command Code 余额与额度面板：在输入框下方显示可用余额，以及 5 小时、每周、每月三个额度窗口。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud coupon balance, used amount and expiry in the sidebar footer, read through the read-only BSS OpenAPI.
description.zh: 在侧栏页脚显示阿里云代金券的剩余余额、已用额度与到期时间，数据来自只读 BSS OpenAPI。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state…

description.en: Side chats and selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness, preserving full conversation history and bringing findings back to the main thread.

description.en: A right-sidebar workbench for legal practice backed by a folder of Markdown notes: SOP lookup, recordings with live transcription and line-level annotations,…

description.en: Unread count on the browser tab icon and the Windows taskbar button, with a chime when a turn finishes.
description.zh: 回合结束时在浏览器标签页图标和 Windows 任务栏图标上显示未读数，并播放提示音。

description.en: Adds a Chats/Files switch to the left-sidebar Workspace header that swaps the session list for a lazily loaded tree of the current session's workspace. Files…
description.zh: 在左侧栏「工作区」标题旁加入「对话 | 文件」切换，把会话列表换成当前会话工作区的按需加载文件树。文件和文件夹可拖进输入框作为 @路径 引用；单击文件打开自带预览；右键可在系统文件管理器中打开所在文件夹或复制路径；条目按 VS Code 的方式显示相对最近一次提交的 Git…

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build mode toggle to the composer, switched with the Tab key or a toolbar button, and remembers a separate model for each mode from the native…

description.en: LeetCode practice bench in the DSH sidebar: live problem bank fetched from leetcode.cn, Java editor with completion and one-tap submit, plus copy-to-chat AI…

description.en: AI-agent-driven automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): drives the harness agent through long-lived multi-round sessions to write and run…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 AI 智能体驱动自动化测试平台：以长期多轮会话驱动 agent 编写并执行 Markdown 用例、产出 bug 报告、修复代码并复验，配套按项目串行的统一队列、开发看板与内置压测。

description.en: Renders a conversation's context as a layered architecture map of goals, decisions, actions, artifacts, risks and open questions, exported as SVG, interactive…

description.en: Select text in a completed assistant answer to ask in a separate floating branch with colored marks, a stage, and a branch tree.

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or…

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in…

description.en: Reskin the whole DSH interface with colour themes, illustration wallpapers, custom cursors and a desktop pet.
description.zh: 给整个 DSH 界面换肤：配色主题、插画壁纸、自定义光标与桌面桌宠。

description.en: Monitor workspace sessions, subagents, todo progress and token usage in a floating panel.
description.zh: 在浮动面板中查看工作区会话、子代理状态、待办进度与 Token 用量。

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Renders LaTeX in the chat — formulas inside your own message bubble, plus a live preview of the composer draft while you type.
description.zh: 在聊天里渲染 LaTeX：你自己的消息气泡内联渲染公式，输入时还会实时预览草稿里的公式。

description.en: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and…
description.zh: 输入框里的 LaTeX 片段展开，触发词表直接取自 Obsidian Latex Suite 的默认片段——138 条打完即出，Tab 依次跳 tabstop，142 条全在一份可编辑的 JSON 里。

description.en: Disk cleanup for Mac (macOS) and Windows: a risk-tier audit and space breakdown, then moves caches, leftovers and similar photos to the Trash or a quarantine…
description.zh: Mac（macOS）与 Windows 磁盘清理：分档体检与空间分布，把缓存、残留与相似照片移入废纸篓或隔离区，可撤销；需永久删除整批后才真正释放空间。

description.en: Manage a GitHub Pages blog from a DSH panel — browse the Markdown articles grouped by tag, edit them in a split editor with a front-matter form, and publish…
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里管理 GitHub Pages 博客：按标签分组浏览 Markdown 文章，用表单填 front matter 并在分屏编辑器里修改，再通过 GitHub REST API 把改动作为一次 commit 发布。

description.en: A top-down arena shooter that lives in the DSH sidebar: an autopilot AI plays the blue whale-fish hero for you while the dsh-pet desktop pet narrates each wave…
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的俯视角生存射击：AI 托管替你把蓝鱼主角打起来，dsh-pet 桌宠逐波解说并念出声；连杀倍率、每 5 波 Boss、局内三选一强化、本机排行榜、成就与皮肤，切面板后还能缩成右下角的小鱼挂件继续打——点一下摸摸它，双击展开画面。

description.en: Settings section that reports token usage: totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning and call count, with breakdowns by model, day, month…
description.zh: 设置中的 Token 用量面板：总量（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写/推理/调用次数），按模型、按天、按月、按项目的明细，以及最近 30 天的按日趋势折线图；历史在 Worker 线程上一次性重建，之后由会话事件实时累加。

description.en: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo…
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Power Mode 打字特效：光标粒子与发光残影，连击越高当前输入行越热（暖黄到红）并升起余烬，按可视字符累计的连击计数，以及合成的按键音与更重的回车冲击音。

description.en: Novel-writing guardrails: 24 novel_* tools enforce fact-ledger consistency, outline and chapter gates, a deterministic machine audit with a zero-token…
description.zh: 网文写作护栏：24 个 novel_* 工具把设定账本一致性、细纲与章节门禁、确定性机审（含零 token 的去 AI 味扫描）和仅提议式修订落到代码里；右侧工作台支持阅读、TTS 朗读、全书检查和带断点续跑的批量起草。

description.en: Fortune-telling toolkit: bazi, ziwei doushu, meihua yijing, liuyao (six-line coin oracle with najia), almanac, chenggu bone-weight, zodiac, date selection,…
description.zh: 玄学算命插件：八字、紫微斗数、梅花易数、六爻纳甲、黄历、称骨、星座、择日、奇门遁甲、风水、起名、合婚、生命数字、人生K线、塔罗、小六壬共 16 个工具，干支、星曜、卦象、骨重全部由本地确定性引擎计算，模型只负责解读；支持公历/农历（含闰月）输入，自动校正中国夏令时与真太阳时，附带十页只读侧栏面板。

description.en: Refuses agent-generated SQL that reads tables or columns outside a configured blacklist or whitelist, returning a structured permission reason instead of…
description.zh: 拒绝智能体生成的越权 SQL：读取的表或字段不在黑白名单策略内时直接拒绝，返回结构化权限原因，不改写查询。

description.en: Desktop and browser automation in one tool surface. Background CDP page reads and clicks escalate to foreground keyboard and mouse; screen observation and…
description.zh: 桌面与浏览器合一的工具面：后台 CDP 读页与点击，必要时升到前台真实键鼠；屏幕观察与应用控制同在这一个工具面里。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Per-directory access gate for DSH: deny / read / full levels for names and paths, roster groups, per-session overrides and an audit log, plus seven…
description.zh: DSH 的按目录访问门禁：对名字与路径给出 deny / read / full 三级权限、名册分组、按会话覆盖与审计日志，另有七个面向模型的 `gate_*` 工具，放宽权限必须由拥有者在面板里批准。用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-isolation-gate`…

description.en: Skill cockpit page in the DSH app-level nav (sidebar.panellist seat): lists every skill this machine actually exposes across all six skill-root kinds, explains…
description.zh: DSH 应用级导航里的「技能中心」页（sidebar.panellist 席位）：列出本机实际暴露的全部技能（覆盖六类技能根），说明某技能为何不可见（被丢弃的原因、根目录缺失、已停用），只改入口文件名（SKILL.md 与 SKILL.md.disabled）即可单独启停；项目级技能根保持只读。

description.en: Provider-agnostic egress monitor. Reports exit IP, country, ASN and latency, plus a per-service view of how that IP looks to AI services; an optional Clash or…
description.zh: 不限厂商的出口体检：出口 IP / 地区 / ASN / 延迟，外加按服务看这个 IP 在 AI 服务眼里的状态；可选 Clash 或 Mihomo 适配器提供节点列表、切换与流量，且从不读取订阅链接或凭据。

description.en: Bilibili-style danmaku overlay for the DSH Web chat area: scroll, top and bottom tracks driven by agent events, three preset packs, optional LLM-generated…
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 对话区叠加 B 站风格弹幕：按 agent 事件生成滚动/顶部/底部三轨弹幕，三套预设包、可选 LLM 生成吐槽、可拖动控制球、分会话弹幕池与历史回放，以及完整设置卡。

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR,…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步…

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web panel for creating, evaluating, repairing, and installing skills, delegating generation to the official generic and Huawei Cloud skill…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能创建面板：调用官方通用/华为云技能创建器生成技能，并提供评测、修复、安装与创建记录。需要 git、bash 与 python3，并能访问 gitcode.com（创建器与参考数据从那里拉取）；创建器默认以 danger-full-access 权限执行 shell 命令。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.
description.zh: 在对话里管理 Gitee 企业版项目：issue、Pull Request、看板与 Gitee MCP 工具链。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls…
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode…
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove`…
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.
description.zh: 给每个子代理标注它实际运行使用的模型路由：父会话目录行增加「mode · 活动状态 · 模型」徽标行，子代理会话页头显示同一读数。

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings.…
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Read-only CNKI bibliographic search for DSH: four MCP tools (search, detail, export, status) drive your own Edge/Chrome through a native-messaging bridge, with…
description.zh: 只读的知网题录检索：四个 MCP 工具（search / detail / export / status）通过原生消息桥驱动你自己的 Edge/Chrome，不下载全文，最小间隔 3 秒，每日上限 300 次。需要先 pip install wensu，运行 wensu setup…

description.en: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。

description.en: Connects free and check-in account channels to DeepSeek: Huawei Cloud CodeArts, Tencent CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy, Qoder, TRAE, Raccoon, LobsterAI, MiniMax, ZCode…
description.zh: 把免费、签到型的模型账号渠道接进 DeepSeek：华为云 CodeArts、腾讯 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy、Qoder、TRAE、Raccoon、LobsterAI、MiniMax、ZCode、讯飞 Loomy。在设置里逐渠道登录，能签到的渠道每日签到（也可开自动），同步可用模型池，模型以普通…

description.en: Connects a GitHub account to DSH from the composer button (OAuth device flow or a personal access token) and exposes one github_api tool for REST calls —…
description.zh: 在对话框左下角连接你的 GitHub 账号（设备流或 Personal Access Token），提供一个 github_api 工具直接调 REST 接口——建仓库、写文件、读 PR 与 Actions，带只读开关和调用记录。改自 Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect（MIT）：不再拒收设备…

description.en: Looks up English words in chat replies by click or selection, showing part of speech, Chinese meaning and exam tags; selecting a pure-English sentence…
description.zh: 点选或划选聊天回复里的英文单词，显示词性、中文释义与考纲标签；划选纯英文句子翻译成中文。词库离线内置：20,499 词条，8,960 个带双语例句，6,374 个带词根分析。

description.en: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character…
description.zh: 侧边栏里的本地优先人物档案：访谈你身边的人并写成 Markdown 卡，能导入酒馆角色卡，也能逐章写小说、拿角色卡和世界书演一段；写进卡的每一条都要能在你写过的材料里找到原句。

description.en: A companion plugin for dsh-pet: gives the desktop pet a persona card, Chinese reasoning lines, click reactions, and a daily diary she writes herself.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的附属插件：给桌面上的鲸鱼娘套上二次元人格，让她的思考过程说中文、被点会回话，还会每天自己写一篇日记。

description.en: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored…
description.zh: 在侧边栏里读 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、TXT、PDF 五种格式的书：分页、目录跳转与书内链接跳转、划线笔记与书签、全文搜索、带原文锚点的 AI 问答、按章蒸馏，并能导入 Legado 格式书源按章抓取在线书籍，随包还带一个陪读教练 skill。PDF 只支持文字版，扫描件与加密 PDF 会被拒绝。
在 DSH 桌面版界面左上角「收起侧边栏」按钮旁加两个按钮，macOS、Windows、Linux 三端都可用。刷新只重载界面层，宿主里正在生成的回合不中断；重启会在确认一次后退出整个应用并自动重新打开，会话与工作区都在。重启是 POST，必须带每次启动随机生成的 token（由插件状态接口提供）；插件不联网、不读会话…
description.en: Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn…
A split-flap salary board for the DSH Web UI. Enter monthly salary, hours per day, working days per month and a start time, and the board settles today's…
description.zh: 挂在 DSH 网页界面上的翻牌工资看板。填好月薪、每天工时、每月工作天数、上班时间，板子每 2 秒结算一次今天赚了多少，用八格翻牌显示（人民币符号、四位整数、小数点、两位小数）。上班前显示 0.00，下班后封顶日薪，跨午夜的班次同样处理。六套配色，可拖到任意位置（位置存在本机），点关闭按钮收进会话顶栏的胶囊。纯前端…

description.en: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of…
description.zh: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

description.en: Local meeting transcription for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS: dual-track recording, live transcript drafts with speaker labels, and @-referenced…
description.zh: 为 Apple Silicon macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地会议转写、麦克风与系统音频录制、说话人标签及 @ 引用的总结、决策与待办。

description.en: Agent-team orchestration sidecar for DSH: teams with a configurable member cap, real sub-agent members with per-member model routing, task DAGs that dispatch…
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 团队编排 sidecar：成员上限可配，成员是真实的 sub-agent 且可单独指定模型；任务按 DAG 依赖自动派发；fs/exec/net/env 四域权限由 broker 强制；运行过程通过 SSE 在 Web 面板实时查看。

description.en: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on…
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部加一行，点击后整页切换成另一台 DSH 主机的 Web GUI（通过回环端口访问），并在该行显示那台主机的会话状态（运行中、有新活动、正等你回答）。

description.en: Zi Wei Dou Shu workbench: manage birth profiles, cast charts with iztro, browse horoscope history, and save AI readings.
description.zh: 紫微斗数工作台：管理生辰档案、用 iztro 排盘、查看运限历史并回填 AI 解读。

description.en: Paper Lens adds a PDF reading sidebar to DeepSeek Harness: select text to translate it in 10 languages, quote passages into the chat, annotate, and optionally…
description.zh: Paper Lens 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏打开 PDF：划词翻译（10 种语言）、把选中的段落引用进对话、批注，并支持本地 llama.cpp 模型翻译。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness settings: add streamable-http or stdio servers, paste Postman-style headers, test connectivity, and toggle each tool so…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具管理器：在设置里添加 streamable-http/stdio 服务器、Postman 式请求头、连通性测试，并按工具开关——停用的工具不会进入模型。

description.en: Import Agent Skills from Git repositories, group them by repository, and enable or disable each one in DSH settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中从 Git 仓库导入 Agent Skills，按仓库分组管理，并逐项启用或停用。

description.en: Monitors IEEE Xplore journal Early Access through Crossref, has an LLM screen every new paper against your keywords, and emails a Markdown weekly digest.
description.zh: 按关键词盯 IEEE 期刊 Early Access：Crossref 抓新收录，逐篇交给大模型研判，生成 Markdown 周报并发到邮箱。

description.en: Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out…
description.zh: 通过 Caddy forward_auth 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供管理员登录，含 Argon2id 口令、可撤销会话、中英界面和侧栏原生退出。

description.en: Provides six code quality skills for code review, architecture audits, technical debt, test quality, health dashboards, and remediation.
description.zh: 提供六个代码质量技能，涵盖代码审查、架构审计、技术债、测试质量、健康看板与修复。

description.en: Hash-anchored file tools for DeepSeek Harness: the read, edit, write and grep tools are replaced by versions where every line is addressed by a variable-length…
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的文件工具换成哈希锚定版本：read、edit、write、grep 被替换为按变长内容锚点定位每一行（而不是行号）的实现，插件同时注册 delete、rename、undo_last_edit、ast_grep、ast_edit、lsp 与 format 七个工具。编辑以统一…

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Unofficial QQ bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (requires a NapCat/OneBot v11 endpoint): editable persona, per-user memory with condensing, session rotation with…

description.en: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured…

description.en: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols,…
description.zh: 按平台把 AI 供应商账号组成算力池，经本地回环代理路由并在 OpenAI、OpenAI-Responses、Anthropic、Gemini 四种协议间桥接，再用带快照回滚的安全直写把代理写进 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Grok、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes…

description.en: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
description.zh: 无限会话画布，区域绑定工作区与智能体预设，可钉住会话卡片、放置便签，带对齐参考线。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard…
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

description.en: Browse Tencent ima knowledge bases in a DSH sidebar panel, preview PDF, Office, note and media files inline, and let the agent search, read and write them…
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏浏览腾讯 ima 的知识库与文件，内置常见格式预览，并让 agent 用 7 个工具检索、读取和写入库内资料（5 个读取、2 个写入：上传文件、收录网页或文章）。

description.en: Registers your own CNB workspace cnb2api gateway as a DSH model provider at a fixed base URL. Follows the workspace address across restarts, auto-starts a…
description.zh: 把你自己的 CNB 工作区 cnb2api 网关登记为 DSH 模型供应商，基址固定不变。工作区重启后自动跟随地址、停止后自动拉起、多账号按可用性切换；面板显示 AI credits 与核时，支持自定义余额警戒线和保底停用阈值。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Manual approval mode ("Manual Mode" / "Ask Mode").
description.zh: 手动审批模式（Manual/Ask Mode）。

description.en: Personal memory sidebar and agent tools for Mory, with search, editing and optional GitHub/Gitee synchronization. Requires a Mory service installed and running…
description.zh: Mory 个人记忆侧栏与智能体工具，支持记忆检索、编辑及可选的 GitHub/Gitee 同步。需在 DSH 宿主机上先安装并启动 Mory 服务。

description.en: Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object…
description.zh: 低成本视频理解工具：video_understand 把 B站链接/BV号/本地视频转成 AVIS 信息层（ASR+场景结构+对象轨迹+YOLO 标签）并输出摘要+问答。问题驱动动态路由分层（L0 ASR / L1 对象轨迹 / L2 关键帧 VLM）、语义层复用（重复提问直接查层）、单次问题预算上限。Python…

description.en: Shows the PlusVibeAPI balance beside the composer, with today's and this month's spend, an estimate for the current chat, and a per-day spend chart; the API…
description.zh: 在输入框旁显示 PlusVibeAPI 余额，附今日与本月花费、本次对话的估算花费和每日花费图表；API 密钥只留在 Host 进程，页面只访问同源路由。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance at the right end of the sidebar account row; click to open the usage page or top up.
description.zh: 在侧边栏左下角账号行的最右侧显示 DeepSeek 账号余额，点击打开用量页或充值页。

description.en: Session strip above the composer: live status for the current session and its sub-agents, other sessions that need you, token usage, and right-click unfinished…
description.zh: 输入框上方的会话概览条：当前会话与子代理的实时状态、需要你处理的其他会话、token 用量，右键可标记未完成。

description.en: Use ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota runway forecast, safe resets, web search, image generation, and Fast mode.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅：OAuth 免密、额度续航预测、安全重置、联网搜索、生图与高速模式。

description.en: Modular execution discipline and autonomous steward for DSH: evidence-first routing across 44 canonical skills, durable state planning, verification gates,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模块化执行纪律与自主管家：覆盖 44 项规范技能的循证路由、持久化状态规划、验证门禁、失败恢复与交互式 Web 看板。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: six tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local…
description.zh: 本地知识库：六个工具，导入 Markdown、文本与 PDF，用 BM25 或 BM25 + 本地向量的混合检索查找，回答时带原文引用。离线运行，不需要数据库服务。需 Node.js 18+ 与 Python 3.9+；导入 PDF 需 pymupdf。

description.en: Exposes a stdio MCP server as native DeepSeek Harness tools. Ships with the official Microsoft Playwright MCP preset, so the agent browses through the Edge or…
description.zh: 把 stdio MCP 服务器变成 DeepSeek Harness 原生工具。默认接微软官方 Playwright MCP，agent 直接操作你已打开、已登录的 Edge 或 Chrome；也可换成任意 stdio MCP 命令。宿主侧插件，不带客户端包，无 npm 依赖。要接管你自己的浏览器，需以远程调试模式启动…

description.en: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters;…
description.zh: 西游师徒卡通桌面悬浮窗：无边框、透明、置顶。点击切换唐僧/孙悟空/猪八戒/沙僧/白龙马，静止自动播放追逐动画。

description.en: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide…
description.zh: 把会话 context 变成浮窗深海摸鱼：context 越长手沉得越深，摸到鱼后服务端掷骰定胜负，中卡铸造镭射收藏卡，五大洋摸鱼、鱼池养成、GitHub 绑定全球排行榜。

description.en: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths,…
description.zh: 每轮第一步注入固定的 system-reminder，要求模型用简体中文思考与回答，代码、命令、文件路径与标识符保持原文。

description.en: Watchdog for quota exhaustion: on a 429 or quota error it creates a recurring schedule that re-sends a continue-the-task prompt until a turn closes normally,…
description.zh: 配额看门狗：遇到 429 或配额错误时建立循环调度，持续重发「继续任务」提示直到某一轮正常结束，长任务不必手动重开；/keep-running list 与 /keep-running cancel <id> 用于查看和取消。需先挂载 @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule（调度由它注册）。

description.en: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every…
description.zh: 把会话工作目录下 .keep-reminder 文件的内容作为 system-reminder 注入，支持三种模式：每会话一次、每轮第一步、每次请求。

description.en: Native Windows notifications when an unawaited background job settles (completed, failed, or stopped), when a conversation turn ends, or when the agent waits…
description.zh: 无人等待的后台任务结算（完成、失败或停止）、对话轮次结束、或 agent 等待你回答问题/工具审批时，弹出 Windows 原生通知。

description.en: Observes detected background download commands and renders live cards with bytes, speed and ETA; silent downloads get a total from a HEAD probe.
description.zh: 观察识别到的后台下载命令并显示实时进度卡片（字节、速度、剩余时间）；静默下载用 HEAD 探测总量。

description.en: Renders a dsh-view fence in an assistant reply as cards — text, tables, charts, Mermaid diagrams and sandboxed HTML widgets — with an editable model prompt, a…
description.zh: 把回答里的 dsh-view 围栏渲染成卡片——文本、表格、图表、Mermaid 图与沙箱 HTML 组件——并提供可编辑的模型提示、render_view 工具和内置技能。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Avernet's Bot Collaboration Network over WebSocket V2, with automatic onboarding, isolated agent sessions, tool-call events, and…
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket V2 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Avernet Bot 协作网络，支持自动注册、Agent 会话隔离、工具调用事件和多 Bot 路由工具。

description.en: A ✦ button in the DSH composer that rewrites the draft into a structured prompt with the session's default model, streams it, and replaces it in one undoable…
description.zh: 输入框右侧的 ✦ 优化按钮：用当前会话的默认模型把草稿改写成结构清晰的提示词，流式预览后一键替换、一步 ⌘Z 还原，逐字保留 {{变量}}。

description.en: Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with…
description.zh: 五个工具，用于构建、测试与运行 Inimerse 引擎，并通过服务端行协议驱动其 Verse 层。需要本机有 Inimerse 源码检出并用 CMake 构建；在 bundle 配置中把 repoRoot 指向它（默认值是作者本机路径）。

description.en: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses…
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的侧栏（macOS 桌面版）：悬停在折叠的侧栏按钮上即可将侧栏浮层展开，选择会话后自动收起，点击按钮固定；另有会话历史前进/后退箭头（⌘[ / ⌘]）。

description.en: Restores a DSH turn interrupted by a crash or restart and lets it carry on, so you don't have to type continue; on Windows it also turns off the built-in…
description.zh: 回合被崩溃或重启打断后，自动恢复会话并让它继续跑，不用你再补一句「继续」；Windows 上还能关掉系统自带的屏保、关屏和睡眠超时（第三方软件的屏保管不到），并可选装一个每分钟一次的计划任务，让 App 被杀后自己回来。

description.en: Delete sessions, optionally with the files each session wrote; deletions go to a trash that lists them by time and restores one or many; a session with a…
description.zh: 删会话，可选择是否带上它写过的文件；删掉的进回收站，按时间列出，可单条或批量还原；正在跑的会话会被拒绝，会话目录以外的文件不动。

description.en: A workbench for engineering and math problems, with nine tools for reading images, solving, plotting and verifying answers, plus four bundled skills. Needs…
description.zh: 工科与数学题解工作台：九个工具覆盖读题、求解、出图与校核，另附四个随包技能。需要带 numpy 与 Pillow 的 Python。读图、图形校核与公式排版依赖你已配置密钥的视觉模型提供商，图片会发给它；未配置密钥时这些功能报失败，其余工具照常可用。

description.en: Sidebar library of every file sent to DeepSeek Harness: search it per workspace or across the host, open or preview a file without copying it, file a copy into…
description.zh: DSH 侧栏文件库：按工作区或全机检索所有发过的文件，可就地打开或预览、一键归档进会话工作区，并以 @library 在对话中复用；同时向 agent 提供 library_list / library_read / library_use 三个工具。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH…

description.en: Schedule a message you are writing in the DSH composer — text, images and files — to be sent later; the Host delivers it after the tab closes, and a message…
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框里正在写的消息（文本、图片、文件）设定发送时间，由 Host 投递，关掉标签页也会发；DSH 关闭期间到点的消息会在下次启动时发送并标记为延迟。勾选重复则改为创建 DSH Automation 任务。选用 DeepSeek 模型、且所选时间落在其工作日高峰时段时，会多一行橙色价格提示。

description.en: Self-contained DSH profile plugin that bridges the cua-driver 0.46.1 Windows kit into DSH as about 63 cua_* background desktop and browser automation tools…
description.zh: 自包含的 DSH profile 插件：把 cua-driver 0.46.1（Windows x86_64）驱动套件桥接进 DSH，提供约 63 个 cua_* 后台桌面与浏览器自动化工具（UIA 观察、不抢焦点的 PostMessage 输入、CDP 浏览器控制、代理光标叠加层、录制与诊断），并内置…

description.en: Adds a browserless deepseek-web provider that drives chat.deepseek.com, with an account pool (rotation, cooldown, auto-failover), in-panel login (browser, or…
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版接成 deepseek-web provider：纯 HTTP 无浏览器，多账号轮换/冷却/自动切换，插件内登录（浏览器，或邮箱+密码+验证码），带 token 用量统计。

description.en: Blocks AI coding agents from editing files without evidence and from running unapproved high-risk commands, and tells quoted dangerous strings apart from…
description.zh: 拦截 AI 编码智能体未取证就改文件、未获授权执行高危命令，并区分「被引用的危险字符串」与「真要执行的命令」。

description.en: Replacement web interface for the unmodified official DSH release: collapsible reasoning groups, a turn timeline with adjustable reading width, cards for tool…
description.zh: 给未改动的官方 DSH 换一套网页界面：思考过程分组折叠、对话轮次时间轴与可调阅读宽度、工具调用卡片、模型与思考强度选择面板、子智能体编队视图、回答里可选的图表与流程图组件、明暗主题和手机布局。从 npm 安装，卸载即恢复官方界面。可选的 jev_presentation_advice 工具只有在你保存…

description.en: Generate structured work reports and summaries from DSH conversations and file changes, with local history and Markdown export.
description.zh: 从会话足迹与文件改动中一键提炼工作成果与待办项，生成结构化日报周报，支持本地留存与 Markdown 导出。

description.en: Keeps plugins you have edited (third-party or built-in) as local git repos: deploys an exact commit only after it builds and passes checks, reverts a change…
description.zh: 把你改过的插件（第三方或内置）保存为本地 git 仓库：只部署已构建并通过检查的指定提交，应用后导致 dsh 崩溃时自动回滚，把 npm 或 git 源的更新合并进你的修改，并可打开智能体会话，把你的修改压缩为原始发布版本之上的一个提交（先建备份分支）。

description.en: Finishes 头歌 (EduCoder) homework over the platform JSON API, with no browser automation. educoder_sweep scans every course for homeworks that still have…
description.zh: 走头歌（EduCoder）平台 JSON API 完成作业，无浏览器自动化。educoder_sweep 扫描所有课程中仍有未通过关卡的作业——已完成的作业直接跳过、一个关卡都不读，因此全量扫描不消耗模型 token——并可一次做完；选择题同样零 token，因为平台会在任意一次提交的响应里回吐标准答案；代码题由模型生…

description.en: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool…
description.zh: DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零…

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves;…
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供多用户登录网关：首次访问创建管理员账户，管理员在 GUI 设置面板中添加和管理用户，普通用户只能看到自己的会话，未登录访问重定向到 /login。

description.en: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue…
description.zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

description.en: Nudges the main agent of a long-running DSH session to report progress at a configurable interval, with exponential back-off, stuck detection, a per-session…
description.zh: 主 agent 长时间执行时按可配置间隔提醒它播报进度，支持指数退避、卡住检测、会话「进度」标签页与手动「立即催一次」。

description.en: Automation for DSH: run whitelisted actions on a schedule, on domain events or manually, with templates, conditions, rate limits and run history.
description.zh: DSH 自动化：按定时、域事件或手动触发白名单 action，含模板、条件、限频与运行记录。

description.en: Calendar for DSH: local calendars, events, participants and reminders, searchable from the workbench agent.
description.zh: DSH 日历：本地日历、事件、参与人与提醒，工作台 agent 可搜索。

description.en: Content connector for DSH: define RSS or webhook sources, sync items into the workbench, keep credentials local and review per-source run logs.
description.zh: DSH 连接器：定义 RSS/Webhook 来源并同步条目进工作台，凭据留在本机，按来源查看运行记录。

description.en: Contacts for DSH: local address book with groups, multi-value fields, search and vCard import/export.
description.zh: DSH 联系人：本地通讯录，支持分组、多值字段、搜索与 vCard 导入导出。

description.en: Danmaku for DSH: play your own bullet comments across the whole interface, or layer them over the desktop itself, with a local library, per-item styles and…
description.zh: DSH 弹幕：把自建弹幕轮播在整个界面，也可叠加到整个桌面，含弹幕库、逐条样式与权重轮播。

description.en: Shared runtime for the Personal Workbench: local SQLite, domain registration, agent tool, HTTP/SSE and opt-in cloud sync for the Tasks, Tags, Sites and Storage…
description.zh: 个人工作台共享宿主：本地 SQLite、业务域注册、agent 工具、HTTP/SSE，以及任务/标签/站点/物品插件的可选云端同步。

description.en: Mail client for DSH: IMAP fetches recent headers only, SMTP sends plain-text mail, and account passwords live in the vault as secret ids.
description.zh: DSH 邮件：IMAP 只抓最近邮件头，SMTP 发纯文本，账户密码由保险箱托管（只存 secretId）。

description.en: Message center for DSH: one send entry for agents and other plugins, inbox with unread counts, stats and a configurable notification sound.
description.zh: DSH 消息中心：给 agent 与其他插件统一的消息发送入口，收件箱、未读数、统计与可配置提示音。

description.en: Salary records for DSH: track pay components, deductions and net pay by pay date, with monthly stats and a full-width records view.
description.zh: DSH 工资记录：按发薪日期记录工资构成、社保与个税扣款、实发金额，支持年度统计与按月聚合。

description.en: Site bookmark manager for DSH: a folder tree, multiple links per site, tags and filtering, with per-folder views.
description.zh: DSH 站点收藏：目录树、每个站点多条链接、标签与筛选，支持按目录浏览。

description.en: Storage records for DSH: names, brands, locations, units, stock text and tags with local SQLite and optional metadata sync.
description.zh: DSH 储物：记录名称、品牌、位置、单位、库存文本与标签，本地 SQLite 保存，可选元数据同步。

description.en: Tag manager for DSH: create, search and delete tags, with soft-delete and per-item mappings used by the workbench task, site and storage plugins.

description.en: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.

description.en: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.

description.en: Long-lived AI companions with isolated memory, WeChat channels, Skills, schedules, heartbeat concerns, and a dependency-aware task board.

description.zh: 中断续跑：对话走到关键节点时（连续两次成功的文件写入/编辑，或一次成功的测试命令），向本地 JSONL 追加一条轻量记录（时间、步骤类型、工具名、≤200 字参数摘要、结果状态），只保留最近 50 条并在 24 小时后过期。DSH 重启后，session_recovery 工具列出未完成的会话，恢复时新建会话，系统提示…

description.en: Store SOP self-check for DSH: keep the SOP as a workspace checklist, ask what is due today, record pass/fail/photo per item (a failure needs a note), append…
description.zh: 门店 SOP 执行自检：把 SOP 写成工作区清单，显示今天该查什么，逐项记录通过/不通过/拍照（不通过必须写备注），按天追加 JSONL 记录，并生成含完成率、异常项和与上一周期对比的纯文本日报。输入框上方带自检条；照片只存档，不做识别。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Lightweight rule-based tools for street-level industry ecosystem work (party-building scenario): format enterprise profile cards, match supply and demand by…
description.zh: 面向党建引领街道产业生态场景的轻量规则工具：生成企业画像卡片、按品类与数量匹配供需、规整政策记录字段（不解析原文）、按优先级给出诉求处理人角色与预计天数；不调用任何外部系统。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that integrates claude-mem: query, context injection, manual save, and session lifecycle over a local claude-mem worker's HTTP API.
description.zh: 接入 claude-mem 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：查询、上下文注入、手动保存，以及通过本地 claude-mem worker 的 HTTP API 处理会话生命周期。

description.en: A permanent status card in the top-right corner of the DSH content area: one line for where this turn's time went (model, tools, waiting), plus collapsible…
description.zh: 内容区右上角的常驻状态卡片：一行写清本轮时间去向（模型/工具/等你），另列可折叠的任务与进度条、会话目标（可编辑/暂停/继续/清除）、已提交计划（可点开在右栏预览）、本次变更文件、带 token 与耗时数字的子智能体行，以及本会话的后台任务（运行中的行带两段确认的终止按钮，已结束的收进一行计数、默认收起）；内容区收窄时…

description.en: Cursor-style IDE mode for DeepSeek Harness: one click on a workspace menu turns the main panel into a VS Code-like workbench with a Monaco editor, file tree,…

description.en: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a…

description.en: Plugin compatibility vet for dsh that compares installed plugins peerDependencies against the running dsh version to flag which ones the startup preflight will…

description.en: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and…
